2.1 内积：把两个向量联系起来2.1 Inner products: relating two vectors

设一个方案使用两种材料，数量为 ，单价为 。总费用是 。把对应分量相乘再相加的运算，在向量计算中经常出现，称为标准。对两个 n 维实列向量，定义为Suppose a plan uses quantities of two materials with unit prices . Its total cost is . Multiplying matching components and adding them is a recurring vector operation, called the standard . For two real n-dimensional column vectors, it is

内积的结果是一个数。比如 、 时，内积为 3。它也有几何意义：当 y 的欧氏长度为 1 时，内积给出 x 沿 y 方向的有符号投影长度。这里“有符号”表示朝着 y 为正，朝相反方向为负。The result is a number. For and , it equals 3. Geometrically, if y has Euclidean length one, the inner product is the signed length of the projection of x onto y. A positive sign means the projection points along y; a negative sign means the opposite direction.

这个投影长度的解释要求 y 为单位向量。若 y 长度不为 1，内积还多乘了 y 的长度；沿 y 的有符号投影长度应为 xᵀy/‖y‖₂。The projection-length interpretation requires a unit y. Otherwise the inner product also includes the length of y; the signed projection length onto its direction is xᵀy/‖y‖₂.

一般的非零向量满足 ，其中 θ 为两向量的夹角， 是通常的欧氏长度。因此内积的正、零、负分别对应锐角、直角和钝角。内积为零称为正交；例如 与 正交。零向量与所有向量内积均为零，但它没有确定的方向或夹角。For nonzero vectors, , where θ is their angle and is Euclidean length. Positive, zero and negative inner products correspond to acute, right and obtuse angles. A zero inner product is called orthogonality: for example, is orthogonal to . The zero vector pairs to zero with every vector but has no defined direction or angle.

已知长度，内积能有多大？How large can the inner product be?

由夹角公式以及 ，内积的绝对值不会超过两向量长度的乘积。这就是柯西–施瓦茨不等式。它把一个含正负号的求和，转化成两个长度的乘积，后面计算会用到这个上界。The angle formula and bound the absolute inner product by the product of the two lengths. This is the . It bounds a signed sum using two lengths, a useful step when we compute dual norms.

也可以不借助夹角证明。若 y≠0，把 x 到直线上点 ty 的距离平方看成 t 的一元二次函数，先展开：We can prove this without angles. If y≠0, treat the squared distance from x to ty as a quadratic function of t. Expand it first:

为了让这个非负量给出尽可能强的界，选择使它最小的 t。二次项系数为正，求导并令其为零就得到最小点：Choose t to minimize this nonnegative quantity and obtain the strongest bound. Its quadratic coefficient is positive, so setting its derivative to zero gives the minimum:

把 t₀ 代回，两个含 t 的项合并成一个负项；距离平方仍非负，因此Substituting t₀ combines the two t-terms into one negative term. Squared distance remains nonnegative, hence

最后开平方，左边是 |xᵀy|，右边是两个非负长度之积，就得到柯西–施瓦茨。y=0 时两边均零。非零向量取等要求最小距离为零，即 x=t₀y，两向量共线，可以同向也可以反向。例如 (3,4)、(6,8) 给两边均为 50。Take square roots: the left side is |xᵀy| and the right side is the product of nonnegative lengths. This proves Cauchy–Schwarz. For y=0 both sides vanish. Equality for nonzero vectors means zero minimum distance, or x=t₀y, so the vectors are collinear in either direction. Vectors (3,4) and (6,8) give 50 on both sides.

补充阅读 · 矩阵也可以作内积Further reading · Inner products of matrices

对于同为 m×n 的矩阵 X、Y，可以把所有元素排成一个长向量，再作内积。也可以借助迹来写：迹 tr 是方阵对角元素之和。For matrices X and Y of the same size m×n, stack all entries into vectors and take their inner product. A compact expression uses the tr, the sum of the diagonal entries of a square matrix.

例如 X=[[1,2],[0,1]]、Y=[[3,0],[4,2]] 的内积为 5。这个内积在后面讨论对称矩阵时仍沿用。For X=[[1,2],[0,1]] and Y=[[3,0],[4,2]], the inner product is 5. We retain this convention when studying symmetric matrices.

练习Exercise

求 (1,2,−1) 与 (2,−1,0) 的内积，并说明两向量的几何关系。Compute the inner product of (1,2,−1) and (2,−1,0), and interpret it geometrically.

提示Hint

按相同位置相乘，再把三项相加。Multiply matching components and add the three products.

解答与核对Solution and check

两向量均非零，内积为零，所以它们正交。Both vectors are nonzero and have zero inner product, so they are orthogonal.

2.2 范数：选择怎样衡量大小2.2 Norms: choosing a measure of size

上节用欧氏长度解释内积。但在实际问题中，“误差小”可能有不同含义。误差向量 x=(3,−4) 表示两项偏差；我们可能关心两项绝对误差之和，也可能只关心最坏的一项。范数把这些不同的大小度量统一起来。The preceding section used Euclidean length. In applications, however, a small error can mean different things. For an error vector x=(3,−4), we might care about the sum of absolute errors or only the worst component. Norms provide a common framework for these measures of size.

一个把每个实向量 x 对应到实数 的函数，如果满足下列三条，就称为范数。下面 α 为任意实数，x、y 为同一空间中的任意向量。A function assigning a real number to each real vector x is a if it satisfies the following three rules, for every real α and all vectors x,y in the space.

第一条保证非零向量有正的长度；第二条说明把向量拉长多少倍，长度也改变多少倍，反向不改变长度；第三条是三角不等式，表示直接走到终点的长度不超过分两段走的长度。常用的三种范数为The first rule gives positive length to every nonzero vector. The second says that scaling a vector scales its length by the absolute factor, so reversing direction preserves length. The triangle inequality says the direct displacement is no longer than the sum of two successive displacements. Three common norms are

它们分别叫 ℓ₁、ℓ₂、ℓ∞ 范数。对 x=(3,−4)，计算结果为 7、5、4：ℓ₁ 累计绝对误差，ℓ₂ 是欧氏长度，ℓ∞ 记录最坏分量。选择哪一个，取决于我们要控制哪一种误差。These are the ℓ₁, ℓ₂ and ℓ∞ norms. For x=(3,−4), their values are 7, 5 and 4. The ℓ₁ norm totals absolute errors, the ℓ₂ norm is Euclidean length, and the ℓ∞ norm records the largest absolute component. The choice reflects which error measure we want to control.

例如欧氏范数的三角不等式可以由上节得到。展开平方，用柯西–施瓦茨控制交叉项：For example, the Euclidean triangle inequality follows from the preceding section. Expand the square and bound its cross term using Cauchy–Schwarz:

两边非负，开平方即可。ℓ₁ 的三角不等式由逐项 相加得到；ℓ∞ 则对每个分量先给同一上界，再取。它们的非负性和齐次性可直接由定义核对。Both sides are nonnegative, so take square roots. For ℓ₁, add the scalar inequalities . For ℓ∞, bound every component by the same sum of the two maxima, then take the . Nonnegativity and homogeneity follow directly from the definitions.

单位球究竟包含什么？What does a unit ball contain?

选定范数后，把允许的长度限制为不超过 1。所有符合条件的向量组成的集合，称为这种范数的，记为 B：After choosing a norm, limit the allowed length to at most one. The set B of all vectors satisfying this restriction is the of that norm:

在二维欧氏范数下，条件是 ，所以单位球是包含内部和边界的圆盘。ℓ₁ 要求 ，得到菱形；ℓ∞ 要求两个坐标的绝对值各不超过 1，得到正方形。In the two-dimensional Euclidean norm, gives a disk including its interior and boundary. The ℓ₁ constraint gives a diamond. The ℓ∞ constraint bounds each coordinate in absolute value by one, giving a square.

有时把这种限制比作“长度预算”：ℓ₁ 下两个坐标共享总量 1，ℓ∞ 下每个坐标各允许到 1。例如 (1,1) 在 ℓ∞ 单位球中，却不在 ℓ₁ 或 ℓ₂ 单位球中。这种比喻只是在解释约束；后面仍以具体范数不等式为准。One can view the restriction as a length allowance: under ℓ₁ the coordinates share a total of one; under ℓ∞ each has its own limit of one. Thus (1,1) belongs to the ℓ∞ ball but not the ℓ₁ or ℓ₂ ball. The analogy explains the constraint; the actual norm inequality remains the precise rule.

让不同方向有不同代价Assigning different costs to directions

如果第一坐标的偏差需要更严格地控制，可以定义 。它等于向量 (2x₁,x₂) 的欧氏长度。其单位球满足 ，沿第一、第二坐标轴分别只能到 ±1/2、±1。第一坐标系数更大，因此同一长度限制允许的偏移更小。If the first error component needs tighter control, use . This is the Euclidean length of (2x₁,x₂). Its unit ball is , reaching ±1/2 and ±1 along the two axes. A larger coefficient allows a smaller displacement under the same length limit.

这确实是范数：变换 T(x)=(2x₁,x₂) 是线性的，而且只有 x=0 才映到零。因而零长度条件成立；齐次性和三角不等式则由欧氏范数通过 T 直接得到。一般矩阵形式叫二次范数，会在 2.11 准备好后完整讨论。This is a norm: T(x)=(2x₁,x₂) is linear and maps only x=0 to zero. That establishes definiteness; homogeneity and the triangle inequality transfer from the Euclidean norm through T. The general construction is a , developed in Section 2.11 after positive definite matrices.

练习Exercise

非零分量个数常记为“ℓ₀”。它是范数吗？请用齐次性判断。The number of nonzero components is often called “ℓ₀”. Is it a norm? Test homogeneity.

提示Hint

比较 x=(1,0) 与 2x 的非零分量个数。Compare the nonzero-component counts of x=(1,0) and 2x.

解答与核对Solution and check

x 和 2x 都只有一个非零分量，计数均为 1。范数的齐次性却要求第二个值等于 2×1=2，所以这种计数不满足范数定义。Both x and 2x have one nonzero component. Homogeneity would require the second value to be twice the first, namely two. The count therefore fails the norm definition.

2.6 内部、边界与极值2.6 Interiors, boundaries and extrema

上节说对偶范数的最大值能取到。为了理解这句话，需要分清“无限接近某个数”和“确实有一个点给出这个数”。先从区间 (0,1] 出发，建立描述集合边缘和极限的语言。The preceding section claimed that the dual-norm maximum is attained. Distinguish approaching a value arbitrarily closely from having a point that produces it. The interval (0,1] will introduce the language of boundaries and limits.

以 c 为中心、半径 r>0，所有距离 c 严格小于 r 的点组成开球。严格小于意味着不包含距离恰为 r 的边界。若 c 周围能放下一个完全位于集合 C 内的开球，就称 c 为 C 的。An open ball with center c and radius r>0 consists of points at distance strictly less than r from c, excluding its boundary. A point c is interior to C if some open ball centered at c lies wholly in C.

例如 1/2 是 (0,1] 的内点；1 却不是，因为任意小的两侧邻域都会包含大于 1 的点。所有点都是内点的集合叫开集。一个点的任意小开球如果既遇到 C，也遇到 C 外面的点，它就是边界点。因此 (0,1] 的边界是 {0,1}；边界点可以属于集合，也可以不属于集合。For (0,1], one half is interior. One is not: every two-sided neighborhood contains points greater than one. A set is open if every point is interior. A boundary point has every open ball meeting both C and its complement. The boundary of (0,1] is {0,1}; boundary points need not belong to the set.

闭集为什么与极限有关？Why do closed sets matter for limits?

序列 xₖ 趋于 x，表示它们之间的距离趋于零。准确地说，给定任意 ε>0，从某一项起所有后续项都满足距离小于 ε。若一个集合包含其中每个收敛序列的极限，就称它为。A sequence xₖ converges to x if its distance from x tends to zero: for every ε>0, all terms after some index have distance less than ε. A set is closed if it contains the limit of every convergent sequence drawn from it.

例如 1/k 都在 (0,1] 中，却趋于被排除的 0，所以这个集合不闭。把缺少的极限点补齐得到闭包，这里的闭包是 [0,1]。有界则表示整个集合可以放进某个有限半径的球内。The sequence 1/k lies in (0,1] but tends to the excluded zero, so the set is not closed. Adding missing limit points gives its closure, here [0,1]. A set is bounded if some ball of finite radius contains it.

把集合中的点排成任意序列，如果总能从中挑出一个收敛到集合内某点的子序列，就称集合具有序列紧致性。在这里的有限维欧氏空间中，这与通常的紧致性等价，也等价于闭且有界。本章引用这条有限维定理。它的关键用途是：连续函数在非空紧集上取得最大值和最小值。下一节会正式解释连续性。A set is sequentially compact if every sequence in it has a subsequence converging to a point of the set. In finite-dimensional Euclidean space this is equivalent to ordinary compactness and to being closed and bounded. We use this finite-dimensional theorem. Its key consequence is that continuous functions attain maxima and minima on nonempty compact sets. The next section formalizes continuity.

这里先用连续性的工作含义：若输入序列趋于某个域内点，输出就趋于该点的函数值。2.7 会把它写成 ε、δ 的精确条件。线性评分满足这个性质，因为柯西–施瓦茨给 |zᵀxₖ−zᵀx|≤‖z‖₂‖xₖ−x‖₂，右边趋零。Use continuity here in a working sense: when inputs converge to a point, outputs converge to its function value. Section 2.7 gives the precise ε,δ condition. A linear score has this property because Cauchy–Schwarz bounds |zᵀxₖ−zᵀx| by ‖z‖₂‖xₖ−x‖₂, tending to zero.

[0,1] 是闭且有界的，所以紧致；(0,1] 虽有界，却因缺少序列 1/k 的极限而不紧致。在有限维，有界性保证可选出收敛子序列，闭性再保证极限仍在集合里；这也是上述等价的基本思路。The closed bounded interval [0,1] is compact. The bounded interval (0,1] is not, since it excludes the limit of 1/k. In finite dimensions boundedness ensures a convergent subsequence; closedness keeps its limit in the set. This is the idea behind the equivalence.

这里引用有限维的 Bolzano–Weierstrass 定理：每个有界序列都有收敛子序列。它是本节紧致性论证使用的分析学结论，并非由闭集定义直接推出。This uses the finite-dimensional Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem: every bounded sequence has a convergent subsequence. It is an analysis theorem used here, not a consequence of the definition of a .

这解释了对偶范数的存在性：有限维范数单位球闭且有界，线性评分连续。闭性可由 验证，有界性由范数等价得到。因此最大评分对应至少一个实际可行点。This explains attainment for the dual norm: the finite-dimensional norm unit ball is closed and bounded, and a linear score is continuous. Closedness follows from ; boundedness follows from norm equivalence. Some actual feasible point produces the maximum score.

上确界与最大值Supremum and maximum

对非空实数集，能压住所有元素的数叫上界；最小的上界叫上确界。最大值还要求这个数本身属于集合。比如在 0<x<1 上最大化 x，上确界为 1，却没有最大值；在 (0,1] 上最大化 x，最大值就是 1。下确界和最小值是反向的概念。无上界时，扩展实数上确界记为 +∞。For a nonempty real set, an upper bound is at least as large as every element. Its least upper bound is the supremum. A maximum additionally belongs to the set. Maximizing x on 0<x<1 gives supremum one but no maximum; on (0,1] the maximum is one. Infimum and minimum reverse these notions. An unbounded-above set has extended-real supremum +∞.

补充阅读 · 相对内部Further reading · Relative interior

平面中的线段没有普通内点，因为每个二维开球都会离开所在直线。若只在这条直线上观察，去掉端点后每点都有一小段邻域留在线段里。这是。一般定义是在集合的仿射包中求内部；仿射包是包含集合的最小仿射空间。A line segment in the plane has no ordinary interior: every two-dimensional ball leaves its line. Within the line, each non-endpoint has a small neighborhood remaining in the segment. This is , formally interior within the affine hull, the smallest affine space containing the set.

练习Exercise

在 (0,1] 上最小化 x，下确界是多少，是否取得？[0,1] 上又如何？Minimize x on (0,1]. What is the infimum, and is it attained? What changes on [0,1]?

提示Hint

用序列 1/k 接近左端点，检查端点是否允许。Approach the left endpoint using 1/k, then check whether it is allowed.

解答与核对Solution and check

(0,1] 中所有 x>0，且 1/k 趋于零，故下确界为零。但零不可行，所以没有最小点。[0,1] 中 x=0 可行，取得最小值零。On (0,1], every x is positive and 1/k tends to zero. The infimum is zero but unattained. On [0,1], x=0 is feasible and attains the minimum zero.

2.3 范数等价：不同长度如何比较2.3 Equivalent norms: comparing lengths

同一个向量用不同范数会得到不同数值。例如 (1,1) 的 ℓ∞ 长度为 1，欧氏长度为 。但在固定的有限维空间中，这些长度可以用固定常数相互控制。先从 ℓ∞ 和 ℓ₂ 的具体比较看起。Different norms give different values: (1,1) has ℓ∞ length one and Euclidean length . In a fixed finite-dimensional space, however, constant factors can bound one norm by another. Start with the concrete comparison of ℓ∞ and ℓ₂.

记最大绝对分量为 M。平方和至少包含一个 M²，每一项又都不超过 M²，总共 n 项。因此Let M be the largest absolute component. The sum of squares contains at least one M², and each of its n terms is at most M². Thus

一般地，若存在与 x 无关的正常数 c、C，使下面的关系对所有 x 成立，就称两种范数等价。常数可以依赖维数和所选范数，但不能随被比较的向量变化。In general, two norms are equivalent if positive constants c,C independent of x give the bounds below for every x. The constants may depend on the dimension and the chosen norms, but not on the vector being compared.

这个结论的一个用途是比较“误差趋于零”。若一列误差 hₖ 在 a 范数下趋零，那么 b 范数被 控制，也趋零；反向使用另一侧界。因而有限维里，换一种等价范数不会改变是否收敛。不过实际数值和容差仍会改变，例如 ℓ∞ 误差小于 0.01，只能推出欧氏误差不超过 。The bounds let us compare errors tending to zero. If tends to zero, then so does , bounded by . The reverse implication uses the other bound. Changing between equivalent norms preserves convergence, but it changes numerical tolerances: an ℓ∞ error below 0.01 gives only a Euclidean bound of .

2.4 诱导矩阵范数：矩阵最多放大多少2.4 Induced matrix norms: maximum amplification

设输入误差是 x，经过线性计算后变成 Ax。即使 x 很小，输出误差也可能被放大。为了给所有输入一个统一保证，我们需要知道：输出长度与输入长度的比值，最大可以是多少？这引出诱导矩阵范数。Suppose an input error x becomes Ax after a linear computation. A small input error can be amplified. To bound the error for every input, ask for the largest possible ratio of output length to input length. This defines an induced matrix norm.

设 A 为 m×n 实矩阵，输入空间选范数 a，输出空间选范数 b。下面 x≠0 保证分母为正。将 x 除以自己的长度，利用齐次性，就能把长度比改写成单位输入的输出长度：Let A be a real m×n matrix, with norm a on the input and norm b on the output. The condition x≠0 makes the denominator positive. Divide x by its length and use homogeneity to rewrite the ratio as the output length for a unit input:

例如 A=diag(3,2) 将 (x₁,x₂) 变成 (3x₁,2x₂)。输入、输出均用欧氏范数时，For A=diag(3,2), the output is (3x₁,2x₂). With Euclidean norms on both sides,

所以放大率不超过 3；取 x=(1,0)，输出长度正好是 3。由“所有输入的上界”和“一个达到上界的输入”，才可断定等于 3。Thus amplification is at most three. Input x=(1,0) produces length three. The bound for every input, together with one attaining input, proves the equals three.

输入、输出都用 ℓ∞ 时Using ℓ∞ for both input and output

现在求任意矩形矩阵的诱导 ℓ∞ 范数。单位输入满足每个 ，而输出第 i 项是第 i 行与 x 的内积。先逐行用绝对值三角不等式：For an arbitrary rectangular matrix, a unit ℓ∞ input satisfies for every component. The i-th output is the inner product of row i with x. Bound each row using the scalar triangle inequality:

对 i 取最大值，得到最大绝对行和这个上界。为了证明它能达到，选一条绝对行和最大的行 i₀，让每个 xⱼ 与该行对应元素同号。零元素对应的 xⱼ 取 1 即可。这使各乘积都非负，因而该行输出恰好等于行和，且输入的 ℓ∞ 长度为 1。所以Taking the maximum over i gives the largest absolute row sum as an upper bound. To attain it, choose a maximizing row i₀ and assign each xⱼ the sign of its entry in that row, using xⱼ=1 for a zero entry. Every product in that row is then nonnegative. Its output equals the row sum, and the input has ℓ∞ length one. Therefore

这样选出的每个坐标都是 ±1，所以输入的最大绝对分量确为 1；某项系数为零时，取 xⱼ=1 不改变该行乘积，也仍满足单位条件。Every chosen coordinate is ±1, so the input maximum absolute component is exactly one. Assigning xⱼ=1 at a zero coefficient leaves the product zero and preserves the unit condition.

例如 A=[[1,−2],[3,1]] 的行和为 3、4。选第二行的符号 x=(1,1)，输出为 (−1,4)，验证最大放大率确为 4。若 A=0，同样的构造给零输出，公式仍成立。For A=[[1,−2],[3,1]], the row sums are 3 and 4. The sign pattern of the second row gives x=(1,1), hence output (−1,4), attaining four. If A=0, the same construction gives zero output and the formula remains valid.

连续经过两个矩阵Applying two matrices successively

矩阵范数定义还给出一个对每个 v 成立的放大界：。v≠0 时由归一化得到；v=0 时两边都为零。若 B 把输入送到中间空间，A 再送到输出空间，而且中间空间两次使用同一范数，就有The definition gives for every v: normalize when v≠0, and use zero on both sides when v=0. If B maps the input to an intermediate space and A maps that space to the output, use the same norm on the intermediate space in both steps. Then

最后对所有单位输入取即可。这称为次乘性。推导没有除以 ，所以 Bx=0 也已覆盖。若 A、B 的中间范数不相容，这两步就不能直接连接。Take the over unit inputs to obtain submultiplicativity. No division by occurs, so Bx=0 is included. Incompatible intermediate norms prevent the two bounds from being directly combined.

例如 A 的放大界若按输入 ℓ₁ 写，就需要 ‖Bx‖₁；若 B 的放大界却只控制 ‖Bx‖₂，还差一步范数比较。直接连乘的版本要求这个中间下标一致。For example, an ℓ₁-input bound for A needs ‖Bx‖₁. If the bound for B controls only ‖Bx‖₂, another norm comparison is needed. Direct multiplication requires matching intermediate subscripts.

取最大列对应的坐标单位向量达到上界，因此诱导 ℓ₁ 范数是最大绝对列和。欧氏诱导范数又叫，2.12 将说明它等于最大奇异值。把矩阵元素直接当坐标，还能定义 Frobenius 范数；它一般不等于谱范数。A coordinate unit vector selecting a largest column attains the bound, so the induced ℓ₁ norm is the largest absolute column sum. 例如 diag(3,2) 的谱范数为 3，为 √13。元素绝对值之和、元素最大绝对值也都是把矩阵视为向量得到的范数，使用时要说明是哪一种。For diag(3,2), the spectral norm is three and the is √13. The sum and maximum of absolute entries are also norms obtained by viewing the matrix as a vector; specify the convention.

For n≥2 it cannot be induced by the same input and output vector norm: every such induced norm has ‖I‖=1, whereas Frobenius gives ‖I‖F=√n. Distinguish these definitions of a matrix norm.

2.5 对偶范数：长度受限时，内积能有多大2.5 Dual norms: maximizing a linear score

矩阵范数关心整个输出向量的长度。另一种常见问题只关心一个数：固定系数 z，在线性评分 中选择 x。如果不限制 x，沿有利方向不断增大 x，就能让评分无界。现在加入长度限制 ，再问最大评分是多少。An induced matrix norm measures the length of an entire output vector. Another common question concerns a single number: choose x to maximize a linear score with fixed coefficients z. Without a restriction on x the score can grow without bound. Impose and ask for the largest score.

以 z=(3,−2) 为例，评分是 3x₁−2x₂。若限制是 ℓ∞ 长度不超过 1，可以取 x=(1,−1)，得到 5；若限制改为 ℓ₁ 长度不超过 1，这个 x 就不再允许。因此最大评分同时取决于 z 和所选范数。For z=(3,−2), the score is 3x₁−2x₂. Under an ℓ∞ bound of one, x=(1,−1) gives five. Under an ℓ₁ bound of one that x is no longer feasible. Thus the largest score depends both on z and on the chosen norm.

固定原范数后，把这个最大评分看成 z 的函数，就得到对偶范数：For a fixed original norm, regard that largest score as a function of z. This is the :

星号表示相对于所选原范数。sup 叫上确界，即所有评分的最小上界；它不一定由某个点取得。下面三种常用范数都将直接构造取等点，所以这些例子确实有最大值。一般范数的取得性等 2.6 介绍集合与极限后再证明；眼下先使用“上界加取等”的具体方法。The star refers to the chosen original norm. The supremum sup is the least upper bound on all scores and need not be attained. For the three norms below we explicitly exhibit attaining points, so these examples have maxima. Section 2.6 establishes attainment for general norms after developing sets and limits. For now use the concrete bound-and-attainment method.

再看 ℓ₁。所有坐标共享绝对值总和 1。任何可行 x 都满足下式；把全部长度分配给 |zₖ| 最大的坐标，且与 zₖ 同号，就达到上界。若 z=0，取 x=0 即可。因此对偶是 ℓ∞。对 (3,−2)，选 x=(1,0)，最大值为 3。For ℓ₁, the coordinates share a total absolute magnitude of one. For (3,−2), x=(1,0) attains three.

最后看 ℓ₂。上节准备的柯西–施瓦茨不等式给上界 。当 z≠0，取与 z 同向的单位向量就取等；z=0 时仍取 x=0。欧氏范数的对偶就是它自己，称为自对偶。For ℓ₂, Cauchy–Schwarz gives the upper bound . If z≠0, a unit vector in the direction of z attains it; if z=0, choose x=0. The Euclidean norm is its own dual, or self-dual.

Each computation used the same method: bound all feasible scores, then exhibit a feasible point attaining the bound. Finding a high-scoring point alone does not prove optimality.

从等值线看最大值Seeing the maximum with level lines

在二维中， 是评分等于 c 的直线，z 是它的法向。增大 c，直线沿 z 的方向移动。与单位球最后一次接触的位置，就是最大可行评分；此时这条直线称为支撑线。图中固定 z 的欧氏长度为 1，只改变方向，因此图中的数值与手算 z=(3,−2) 不同。In two dimensions, is the line of score c, with normal z. 为什么它也是范数，又有什么用？Why is it a norm, and how is it used?

Maximizing the inner product or its absolute value therefore gives the same value. Choosing x=0 gives nonnegativity; for z≠0, choosing gives a strictly positive score. Positive scaling factors pull out of the maximum; for negative factors use symmetry. This establishes absolute homogeneity.

正数缩放会把所有候选评分及其最小上界同时缩放；α=0 时所有值为零。负数情形换元 u=−x，因 B 关于原点对称，可选向量仍是整个 B。这就是负号变成绝对值的具体理由。Positive scaling scales every candidate score and its least upper bound; α=0 gives zero throughout. 2.10 值域与零空间：方程能否解、解是否唯一2.10 Range and nullspace: solvability and uniqueness

方程 Ax=b 可能无解，也可能有许多解。前面求最小二乘时也会遇到这两个问题。要区分它们，分别观察矩阵能产生哪些输出，以及哪些输入会完全消失。The equation Ax=b may have no solution or many solutions, questions also arising in least squares. Separate them by asking which outputs A can produce, and which inputs disappear under A.

设 A 为 m×n 矩阵。所有 Ax 构成；所有被映到零的输入构成零空间。值域在输出空间 Rᵐ 中，零空间在输入空间 Rⁿ 中。For an m×n matrix A, the consists of all outputs Ax, and the nullspace consists of all inputs mapped to zero. The range lies in the output space Rᵐ; the nullspace lies in the input space Rⁿ.

例如 A=[[1,1],[0,0]]，输出为 (x₁+x₂,0)，所以值域是横轴。要让输出为零，只需 x₂=−x₁，故是所有 (t,−t)。因此 b=(2,1) 不在值域中，方程无解；b=(2,0) 则有所有解 (t,2−t)。For A=[[1,1],[0,0]], the output is (x₁+x₂,0), so the range is the horizontal axis. Zero output requires x₂=−x₁, giving vectors (t,−t). Thus b=(2,1) is unreachable, while b=(2,0) has all solutions (t,2−t).

一般地，若 x₀ 是一个解，另一个 x 也是解恰好要求 A(x−x₀)=0。因此全部解就是一个特解加任意零空间向量：In general, if x₀ is one solution, another x is a solution exactly when A(x−x₀)=0. Thus every solution is a particular solution plus a nullspace vector:

秩与自由度Rank and degrees of freedom

由一组向量的所有线性组合形成的集合叫它们张成的空间。能生成该空间的最少向量数是它的维数。A 的值域由各列张成，其维数叫秩。零空间维数则数出保持输出不变时，还有多少个独立的输入自由度。秩—零度定理说The span of vectors consists of their linear combinations. Its dimension is the smallest number of vectors needed to generate it. The columns of A span its range, whose dimension is the rank. The nullspace dimension counts independent input freedoms leaving the output unchanged. The rank–nullity theorem states

这里的独立输入自由度，指描述零空间向量时所需的独立自由参数个数。例如 (t,−t) 只需要一个实参数 t，所以该零空间维数为 1。Independent input freedom means the number of independent free parameters describing a nullspace vector. For example, (t,−t) needs just one real parameter, so this nullspace has dimension one.

满列秩指秩等于输入维数 n，此时零空间只有零，方程一旦可解便唯一。满行秩指秩等于输出维数 m，此时所有 b 都在值域中。前例秩为 1，输入维数为 2，零空间维数便是 1。Full column rank means rank n, so the nullspace is {0} and any solvable equation has a unique solution. Full row rank means rank m, so every b is reachable. The example has rank one, input dimension two and nullspace dimension one.

补充阅读 · 正交补关系Further reading · Orthogonal complements

与一个空间中每个向量都正交的向量组成正交补，记为上标 ⊥。Ax=0 意味着 x 与 A 每一行正交，所以 N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥。同理 N(Aᵀ)=R(A)⊥，有限维中再取正交补得到 R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥。最小二乘残差与所有可达方向正交，正是这组关系的应用。The orthogonal complement, denoted ⊥, contains vectors orthogonal to every vector in a space. Ax=0 says x is orthogonal to every row, hence N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥. Likewise N(Aᵀ)=R(A)⊥, and taking complements in finite dimensions gives R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥. Orthogonality of a least-squares residual to reachable directions is an application.

A=[[1,2],[0,0]]。写出值域、零空间，并求 Ax=(3,0) 的全部解。For A=[[1,2],[0,0]], find its range, nullspace and all solutions to Ax=(3,0).

提示Hint

解答与核对Solution and check

Ax=(x₁+2x₂,0)。值域为横轴，零空间为 (−2t,t)。取特解 (3,0)，全部解为 (3−2t,t)，t 为任意实数。Ax=(x₁+2x₂,0). The range is the horizontal axis; the nullspace is (−2t,t). Starting with particular solution (3,0), all solutions are (3−2t,t) for real t.

阅读路线提示：下面用到对称矩阵P的二次型。对每个v都有vᵀPv≥0称半正定；对每个非零v都有vᵀPv>0称正定。正文节号仍按课件章节保留；本路线将Hessian放在下一阶段介绍。Route note: for a symmetric P, positive semidefinite means vᵀPv≥0 for every v; positive definite means strict positivity for every nonzero v. Section numbers retain the ordinary chapter order; this route introduces Hessians in the following stage.

2.11 特征分解、正定性与二次范数2.11 Eigenvalues, definiteness and quadratic norms

上节研究了输入是否消失，现在进一步找矩阵作用特别简单的方向：一个非零 v 如果经过 P 后仍在原来直线上，即 Pv=λv，就叫特征向量，λ 叫特征值。λ 可以为负，表示缩放时还反向；λ=0 则表示这个方向完全消失。We now seek directions where a matrix acts simply. A nonzero v with Pv=λv is an eigenvector, and λ is its eigenvalue. A negative λ includes a reversal of direction; λ=0 means that direction disappears.

对实对称矩阵 P，谱定理保证存在一组互相正交的单位特征向量。将它们作 Q 的列，特征值放在对角矩阵 Λ 中，就有下式。QᵀQ=I 表示这些列构成正交单位坐标；I 为单位矩阵。For a real symmetric P, the spectral theorem provides an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors. Put them in the columns of Q and their eigenvalues in diagonal Λ. The identity QᵀQ=I expresses orthonormal coordinates; I is the identity matrix.

这是实对称矩阵的一条定理。它与 2.1 的正交概念一致：若 Pv=λv、Pw=μw，则由 Pᵀ=P 有 λvᵀw=vᵀPw=μvᵀw。不同特征值 λ≠μ 因而强迫 vᵀw=0。重复特征值对应的空间也可以选正交单位基；定理的存在性思路见本节补充。This is a theorem about real symmetric matrices. Orthogonality has exactly the meaning from Section 2.1: if Pv=λv and Pw=μw, symmetry gives λvᵀw=vᵀPw=μvᵀw. Distinct eigenvalues therefore force vᵀw=0. An orthonormal basis can also be chosen within a repeated-eigenvalue space; further reading below sketches existence.

例如 P=[[2,1],[1,2]]：P(1,1)=3(1,1)，P(1,−1)=(1,−1)。把两个方向各除以 √2 后，就得到 Q 的两列，特征值为 3、1。换坐标 y=Qᵀx，二次型便化成没有交叉项的加权平方和：For P=[[2,1],[1,2]], P(1,1)=3(1,1) and P(1,−1)=(1,−1). Divide these directions by √2 to form Q; the eigenvalues are three and one. In coordinates y=Qᵀx, the quadratic form becomes a weighted sum of squares with no cross terms:

所以 P 半正定恰好等价于所有 λᵢ≥0；P 正定恰好等价于所有 λᵢ>0。充分性由平方和直接看出；必要性只需让 x 逐个取单位特征向量。前节对 Hessian 的方向判断，现在就能转为特征值判断。Consequently, P is positive semidefinite exactly when every λᵢ≥0, and positive definite exactly when every λᵢ>0. Sufficiency follows from the squares; necessity follows by testing each unit eigenvector. This converts the directional Hessian test into an eigenvalue test.

写 P⪰Q 表示 P−Q 半正定，它要求所有 x 都有 xᵀPx≥xᵀQx。这是比较方向费用的矩阵不等式，不能当成每个元素分别比较。例如 diag(−1,−1) 的行列式虽为正，却在每个非零方向给负值，故行列式为正不能单独判定正定。The notation P⪰Q means P−Q is PSD, equivalently xᵀPx≥xᵀQx for every x. It compares directional costs, not entries. For example, diag(−1,−1) has positive determinant but a negative quadratic form in every nonzero direction; a positive determinant alone does not establish positive definiteness.

矩阵平方根与二次范数Matrix square roots and quadratic norms

若 P 正定，每个特征值都正，可以将它们逐个开平方，再换回原坐标，得到。将它们取平方根倒数，则得到逆平方根。If P is positive definite, take square roots of its positive eigenvalues and transform back to get its . Taking reciprocal square roots gives the inverse square root.

二者对称且可逆，并满足 P½P½=P。于是一般二次范数可以写成变换后的欧氏长度：Both are symmetric and invertible, with P½P½=P. A quadratic norm is therefore the Euclidean length after a linear transformation:

逐条检查范数条件：‖x‖P=0 等价于 ‖P½x‖₂=0，再等价于 P½x=0。P½ 可逆，故这只在 x=0 时发生。其次 P½(αx)=αP½x，把欧氏范数的齐次性转移过来；最后 P½(x+y)=P½x+P½y，应用欧氏三角不等式便得 ‖x+y‖P≤‖x‖P+‖y‖P。这把 2.2 的例子推广到一般正定矩阵。若 P 仅半正定，非零零空间向量也可能长度为零，只能得到半范数，含 P⁻¹ 的公式也不能照用。Check the norm conditions separately. The equality ‖x‖P=0 is equivalent to ‖P½x‖₂=0, hence to P½x=0. Invertibility makes this equivalent to x=0. Next, P½(αx)=αP½x transfers Euclidean homogeneity. Finally P½(x+y)=P½x+P½y and the Euclidean triangle inequality give ‖x+y‖P≤‖x‖P+‖y‖P. This generalizes Section 2.2. If P is only PSD, nonzero nullspace vectors may have zero length, giving a seminorm; inverse formulas need not apply.

读图时要区分两种椭圆。线性像 Au 描述输入球经过矩阵变换后到哪里；A=diag(3,2) 的半轴为 3、2。二次范数单位球描述哪些原输入满足 xᵀPx≤1；P=diag(4,1) 的半轴为 1/2、1。一般正定 P 的预算球沿特征方向的半轴为 ，因为该方向满足 λᵢyᵢ²≤1。Distinguish the two ellipses. The linear image Au is where a transformed input ball goes; A=diag(3,2) gives semiaxes three and two. The quadratic-norm ball is the set of original inputs satisfying xᵀPx≤1; P=diag(4,1) gives semiaxes one half and one. For a positive definite P, the semiaxis in eigen-direction i is , since λᵢyᵢ²≤1.

用已有工具求二次范数的对偶Computing the quadratic dual norm

回到 2.5：固定 z，在 xᵀPx≤1 中最大化 zᵀx。先用对角例子 P=diag(9,1)、z=(3,2)。设 u=(3x₁,x₂)，约束变成 u₁²+u₂²≤1，目标同时变成 u₁+2u₂。欧氏对偶公式立即给最大值 √5，取 u=(1,2)/√5。换回 x=(1/(3√5),2/√5)，约束和目标都可直接核对。Return to Section 2.5: maximize zᵀx subject to xᵀPx≤1. For P=diag(9,1), z=(3,2), set u=(3x₁,x₂). The constraint becomes u₁²+u₂²≤1 and the objective becomes u₁+2u₂. The Euclidean dual formula gives √5, attained at u=(1,2)/√5. Transform back to x=(1/(3√5),2/√5) and check both feasibility and the objective.

一般情形使用同样的想法。换元 u=P½x 可逆，必须同时变换约束和目标。柯西–施瓦茨随后给出统一上界 d：Use the same idea generally. The change of variables u=P½x is invertible; transform both the constraint and the objective. Cauchy–Schwarz then gives the uniform bound d:

当 z≠0 时 d>0。为达到刚才的上界，柯西–施瓦茨要求 u 与 P⁻½z 同向；而约束要求它的欧氏长度不超过 1，最大化时应把长度取到 1。因此先确定换元后的取等点：For z≠0, d>0. Equality in Cauchy–Schwarz requires u to point along P⁻½z. The constraint limits its Euclidean length to one, and a maximum uses the full length. First choose the attaining point in transformed coordinates:

再换回原变量。由 u=P½x 可得 x=P⁻½u，且 P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹，所以Now return to the original coordinates. Since u=P½x, we have x=P⁻½u; using P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹ gives

最后在原约束和原目标中分别核对，避免只选对方向却没满足长度限制：Finally check the original constraint and objective separately, making sure that the length restriction is satisfied as well as the direction:

这个点可行并达到所有点的统一上界 d，因此所求对偶范数就是The point is feasible and attains the uniform bound d, so the dual norm is

z=0 时直接取 x=0，最大值为零；不能使用含 d 的除法。这个结果解释了倒数权重：原长度对一个方向惩罚越重，该方向可选的位移越短，因此线性评分的最大响应会受抑制。For z=0, take x=0 and the value is zero; do not divide by d. The inverse weights have an interpretation: heavier penalties in the original length allow shorter displacements and reduce the corresponding maximum linear response.

沿单位特征向量 eᵢ 取 z=eᵢ，对偶值就是 1/√λᵢ。λᵢ 增大时，P⁻¹ 在该方向的特征值 1/λᵢ 减小，因而这个方向的最大响应也减小。For a unit eigenvector eᵢ, z=eᵢ has dual value 1/√λᵢ. Increasing λᵢ decreases the corresponding inverse eigenvalue 1/λᵢ and the maximum response in that direction.

det 表示行列式。对正定矩阵 X，它等于正特征值的乘积，所以 log det X 有意义。课件例子设 ，其中 Fᵢ 为实对称矩阵，定义域要求 X(x)≻0，目标为 f(x)=−log det X(x)。The determinant det of a positive definite X is the product of its positive eigenvalues, so log det X is defined. The slide example sets with symmetric Fᵢ, domain X(x)≻0, and f(x)=−log det X(x).

练习Exercise

P=[[2,1],[1,2]]，z=(1,−1)。求二次范数的对偶值及取等点，并检查可行性。For P=[[2,1],[1,2]], z=(1,−1), find the quadratic dual value and maximizer, and check feasibility.

提示Hint

z 是哪个特征方向？先算 Pz，就能避免直接求逆。Which eigen-direction is z? Compute Pz to avoid an explicit inverse.

关键步骤Key steps

Pz=z，所以P⁻¹z=z。由d²=zᵀP⁻¹z计算对偶值，再把x*=P⁻¹z/d代回预算和目标。Pz=z gives P⁻¹z=z. Compute d²=zᵀP⁻¹z, then substitute x*=P⁻¹z/d into the original constraint and objective.

解答与核对Solution and check

P 的特征值为 3、1，故正定。Pz=z，所以 P⁻¹z=z。于是 d=√(zᵀz)=√2，取 x*=z/√2。P has eigenvalues three and one, so it is positive definite. Pz=z implies P⁻¹z=z, giving d=√(zᵀz)=√2 and x*=z/√2.

统一上界已经由一般证明给出，这个可行点达到它，因此完成最优性证明。The general proof supplies the uniform bound, and this feasible point attains it, completing optimality.

补充阅读 · 谱定理的存在性思路Further reading · An existence argument for the spectral theorem

在欧氏单位球面上，连续的 qᵀPq 取得最大值，取一个最大点 q。对任意 w⊥q，沿单位方向 (q+tw)/‖q+tw‖₂ 改变 q；这个一元函数在 t=0 处导数为零，算得 2wᵀPq=0。因此 Pq 没有垂直于 q 的分量，只能等于 λq。The continuous qᵀPq attains a maximum on the Euclidean unit sphere. At a maximizer q, perturb along (q+tw)/‖q+tw‖₂ for any w⊥q. The derivative at t=0 is zero, giving 2wᵀPq=0. Thus Pq has no component orthogonal to q and equals λq.

再看 q 的正交补：若 x⊥q，则 qᵀPx=(Pq)ᵀx=0，所以 P 会把这个低一维空间映回自身。在这个空间重复上述构造，直至一维，就得到完整正交特征基。这里同时用到了对称性、球面的紧致性和一元求导。For x⊥q, qᵀPx=(Pq)ᵀx=0, so P preserves the orthogonal complement of q. Repeat the argument in this lower-dimensional space until dimension one to obtain a full orthonormal eigenbasis. The argument uses symmetry, compactness and one-variable differentiation.

2.7 定义域与连续性2.7 Domains and continuity

一个函数需要同时说明计算规则和允许的输入。例如实数范围的 −log x 要求 x>0。忽略这个限制，就可能对根本不存在的函数值求导或作比较。所有允许输入构成，记为 dom f。A function needs a rule and a set of allowed inputs. For example, real −log x requires x>0. Ignoring that condition can lead to differentiating or comparing nonexistent values. The allowed inputs form the domain, written dom f.

对 ，点 x₀ 必须属于 D，才能讨论该点连续性。连续的含义是：D 中的输入足够接近 x₀，输出就足够接近 f(x₀)。用极限写为For , x₀ must belong to D to discuss continuity there. Continuity means that inputs in D sufficiently close to x₀ have outputs close to f(x₀). In limit notation,

也就是任给输出容差 ε>0，能找到输入容差 δ>0，使所有 且 的输入，都满足 。δ 可以依赖 x₀ 和 ε，但要同时适用于这片邻域中的所有输入。For every output tolerance ε>0 there is an input tolerance δ>0 such that every x in D with satisfies . The choice of δ may depend on x₀ and ε but must work for all allowed inputs in that neighborhood.

例：1/x 在哪里连续？Example: where is 1/x continuous?

取任意 x₀≠0。先限制 ，这样 ，分母就远离零。于是Fix x₀≠0. First require , ensuring so the denominator stays away from zero. Then

取 即满足连续性要求。故 1/x 在每个非零点连续。它靠近 0 时无界并不矛盾，因为 0 在定义域之外。Choose . Thus 1/x is continuous at every nonzero point. Its divergence near zero does not contradict this, since zero is outside its domain.

因为 δ 不超过第一个量，分母估计成立；又因 δ 不超过第二个量，上面的差值严格小于 (2/|x₀|²)δ≤ε。两个要求因而同时满足。The first bound on δ validates the denominator estimate. The second makes the difference strictly less than (2/|x₀|²)δ≤ε. Both requirements are therefore met simultaneously.

后面讨论凸函数还会要求定义域是凸集，即任意两点间的线段仍在域内。(0,∞) 满足此条件；实数轴去掉零却不满足，因为 −1、1 的中点被排除了。因此同一公式在不同定义域上，需要分别判断。Convex-function arguments later require a convex domain: a segment joining two domain points must remain in the domain. The interval (0,∞) satisfies this, but the real line without zero excludes the midpoint of −1 and 1. The same formula on different domains requires separate analysis.

至此也补齐了 2.6 的极值定理中“连续”的精确含义。例如在任意范数单位球上最大化 zᵀx：球非空、闭且有界，评分连续，所以极值定理保证上确界由某个点取得。存在性与取等点的具体计算是两项不同任务。This completes the precise continuity assumption in Section 2.6. For maximizing zᵀx on any norm unit ball, the ball is nonempty, closed and bounded and the score is continuous, so the supremum is attained. Establishing existence and computing a maximizer are separate tasks.

Continuity alone does not ensure extrema; this domain fails the compactness assumption of the extreme-value theorem.

4 · 凸集的定义证明4 · Convex set proofs

3.1 仿射集：沿直线延伸3.1 Affine sets: extending along lines

给定两个不同的点 x、y，直线上每个点都能写成 (1−θ)x+θy。θ=0、1 给端点，0<θ<1 给中间点，其他实数给向两侧延伸的点。若一个集合包含其中任意两点所在的整条直线，就称为。For distinct points x,y, their line consists of (1−θ)x+θy for real θ. Values zero and one give the endpoints, intermediate values give the segment, and other values extend beyond it. A set containing the entire line through any two of its points is affine.

例如 x₁+x₂=1 是一条不经过原点的直线，因此是仿射集。线性子空间还要求包含原点，并对任意线性组合封闭；它比仿射集多了这个原点条件。非空仿射集总可以看成某个线性子空间整体平移。The line x₁+x₂=1 is affine despite not passing through the origin. A linear subspace contains zero and is closed under arbitrary linear combinations. Every nonempty is a translate of a linear subspace.

例：线性方程的解集Example: solutions of linear equations

设 C={x:Ax=b}。要证明它仿射，取任意两个解 x、y 及任意实数 θ，直接代入：Let C={x:Ax=b}. Choose any two solutions x,y and any real θ, then substitute:

混合点仍满足同一方程，所以证明完成，不需要 A 可逆或解唯一。无解时 C 为空，条件因没有可选的两点而自动成立。非空时，第二章的 x₀+N(A) 也直接说明它是平移后的子空间。The mixed point solves the equation, without requiring invertible A or a unique solution. If C is empty, the condition holds vacuously. When nonempty, Chapter 2 representation x₀+N(A) also shows it is a translated subspace.

含一组点的最小仿射集叫仿射包。它由这些点的仿射组合组成：系数和等于 1，但系数允许为负。The smallest affine set containing given points is their affine hull. It consists of affine combinations, whose coefficients sum to one but may be negative.

3.2 凸集、凸包与锥3.2 Convex sets, convex hulls and cones

实际方案往往只能按非负比例混合，不能向两侧无限延伸。因此把上一节 θ 的范围限制到 [0,1]：若任意两点之间的整段线段都留在集合内，就称集合凸。Practical plans are usually mixed in nonnegative proportions rather than extended indefinitely. Restrict θ to [0,1]: a set is convex if it contains the whole segment joining any two of its points.

圆盘是凸的，只有圆周的集合不是：圆周上的两个对径点，其中点是圆心，不在圆周上。每个仿射集都凸，因为它允许更广的 θ；反向一般不成立，例如有限线段凸，却不含向外延长的直线。A filled disk is convex, but its circumference alone is not: the midpoint of opposite boundary points is the missing center. Every affine set is convex because it permits all real θ. A finite segment shows the converse fails.

含 S 的最小凸集叫。它由有限个点的凸组合组成，即非负系数、总和为 1。三点不共线时，凸包是填满的三角形。The is the smallest convex set containing S. It consists of finite convex combinations: nonnegative coefficients summing to one. Three noncollinear points generate a filled triangle.

为什么两点定义也允许有限点混合？把前 k−1 项先归一化成一个点，再与第 k 项做两点混合，逐次归纳即可。若最后一项权重为 1，其余都为零，直接就是原点列中的第 k 点。这种分组方法在第四章证明 Jensen 不等式时会详细使用。Why does the two-point definition allow finite mixtures? Normalize the first k−1 terms to one point, then mix with the last point, using induction. If the last weight is one, all others vanish and the combination is just that point. Chapter 4 uses this grouping method in detail for Jensen inequality.

只允许放大缩小：锥Scaling without a fixed total: cones

集合 K 若对非负缩放封闭，即 x∈K、α≥0 时 αx∈K，就叫锥。非空锥因此包含原点。若它也凸，就叫凸锥；把缩放和两点混合结合起来，可知凸锥对任意非负线性组合封闭。一般锥不自动凸，例如两条不同方向的射线之并。A cone is closed under nonnegative scaling: x∈K and α≥0 imply αx∈K. A nonempty cone therefore contains zero. A convex cone is also convex; scaling and mixing together make it closed under nonnegative combinations. A cone need not be convex: the union of two distinct rays may fail the segment test.

上式的锥包包含原点。比较这四类组合时，只检查系数限制就能分清：线性组合无系数限制；仿射组合要求和为 1；凸组合再要求非负；锥组合只要求非负，不固定总和。The conic hull above contains zero. The coefficient rules distinguish the constructions: linear combinations have no restrictions; affine combinations sum to one; convex combinations additionally have nonnegative coefficients; conic combinations require nonnegative coefficients without fixing their sum.

练习Exercise

S={(1,0),(0,1)}。写出它的凸包和锥包。For S={(1,0),(0,1)}, describe its convex and conic hulls.

提示Hint

凸包固定系数和为 1，锥包只要求各系数非负。The convex hull fixes the coefficient sum to one; the conic hull requires only nonnegativity.

解答与核对Solution and check

凸包为 x₁,x₂≥0 且 x₁+x₂=1 的线段。锥包为 x₁,x₂≥0 的整个第一象限，包含原点。The convex hull is the segment x₁,x₂≥0 with x₁+x₂=1. The conic hull is the entire nonnegative quadrant including zero.

3.3 常见凸集：从不等式读出形状3.3 Common convex sets from inequalities

认识凸集时，既可以画图，也要能从约束证明。先看一个非零向量 a：等式 aᵀx=b 给出，a 是法向；在二维它是一条直线。把等号换成 ≤，得到一侧的闭半空间。要求 a≠0，是为了排除整个空间或空集这种退化等式。To recognize convex sets, combine pictures with proofs from constraints. For nonzero a, aᵀx=b defines a with normal a, a line in two dimensions. Replacing equality by ≤ gives a closed halfspace. The condition a≠0 excludes degenerate equations defining all space or nothing.

若两个点都满足 aᵀx≤b，其凸组合也满足：线性运算把左边变成两项的加权平均，而平均仍不超过 b。所以凸，超平面的证明与 3.1 相同。If two points satisfy aᵀx≤b, their convex combination also does: linearity makes the left side the weighted average of two values at most b. Thus halfspaces are convex; hyperplanes follow Section 3.1.

球的证明为什么用三角不等式？Why use the triangle inequality for balls?

范数球以 x₀ 为中心、半径 r≥0，条件为 ‖x−x₀‖≤r。取球内 x、y，先从混合点减去球心，再用齐次性和三角不等式：A norm ball of center x₀ and radius r≥0 has ‖x−x₀‖≤r. For x,y in the ball, subtract the center from their mixture, then apply homogeneity and the triangle inequality:

这对每个 θ∈[0,1] 成立，所以球凸；r=0 时球只有球心，也已包含在证明中。正定 P 定义的椭球 (x−x₀)ᵀP(x−x₀)≤1 是二次范数球，因而也凸。This holds for all θ∈[0,1], proving convexity, including r=0 where the ball is a singleton. For positive definite P, the ellipsoid (x−x₀)ᵀP(x−x₀)≤1 is a quadratic-norm ball and is therefore convex.

数值核对一次：球心 c=(1,−1)、半径2，取 x=(3,−1)、y=(1,1)，两点到球心距离都为2。中点为 (2,0)，到球心距离为 √2≤2。这个算例帮助读图，上面的三角不等式才负责所有点与所有混合比例。For a numerical check, use center c=(1,−1), radius two, and points x=(3,−1), y=(1,1), each at distance two. Their midpoint (2,0) has distance √2≤2. The example aids interpretation; the triangle-inequality proof covers all points and mixture weights.

例：离哪个点更近？Example: which point is closer?

给定不同的 a、b，问哪些位置 x 离 a 不比离 b 远。距离本身含平方根，但两边非负，平方不会改变不等号。展开后 xᵀx 消去，留下线性条件：For distinct a,b, find locations x no farther from a than from b. Both distances are nonnegative, so squaring preserves their comparison. Expand and cancel xᵀx to obtain a linear inequality:

b−a≠0，故它确实是半空间。图中 a=(0,0)、b=(2,0)，得到 x₁≤1。边界是垂直平分线，包含边界是因为题目允许距离相等。Since b−a≠0, this is a genuine . In the diagram a=(0,0), b=(2,0) give x₁≤1. The boundary is the perpendicular bisector and is included because equal distances are allowed.

平方距离后消去xᵀx。这里2(b−a)=(8,−4)，右端平方差为4，最后检查a应可行、b不应可行。Square and cancel xᵀx. Here 2(b−a)=(8,−4), and the squared-length difference is four. Check that a is included and b excluded.

代入 a 得 −4≤1，代入 b 得 6≤1 不成立，与距离含义一致。Point a gives −4≤1; point b gives the false 6≤1, agreeing with the distance interpretation.

故混合点可行。半径换成0时，同一推导右边为0，集合仅含 c，所以也凸。The mixture is feasible. At radius zero the same upper bound is zero and the set is the singleton c, also convex.

5 · 凸函数与Jensen5 · Convex functions and Jensen

4.1 凸函数：比较两种平均4.1 Convex functions: comparing two averages

取平方费用 f(x)=x²，输入 −1、3 的平均是 1，费用为 1；先算两份费用再平均，却得到 (1+9)/2=5。凸函数把这种比较推广到任意两点和任意混合比例。For squared cost f(x)=x², averaging inputs −1 and 3 gives one with cost one. Averaging the original costs gives (1+9)/2=5. Convexity generalizes this comparison to every pair of inputs and every mixture weight.

定义要求 f 的定义域 D 先是凸集，且上式对所有 x,y∈D 成立。左边是先平均输入再求函数；右边是先求函数再平均输出。图上就是函数曲线不高于连接两端图像点的弦。只检查几组点可帮助理解，不能代替对所有点的证明。The domain D must first be convex, and the inequality must hold for all x,y∈D. The left averages inputs before evaluation; the right averages outputs. Geometrically the graph lies below each chord. Checking a few points illustrates the definition but does not prove it.

把不等号反过来得到凹函数；等价地 f 凹当且仅当 −f 凸。若 x≠y、0<θ<1 时总是严格不等式，称严格凸。端点 θ=0、1 不要求严格，因为此时左右本来相等。Reversing the inequality defines concavity; f is concave exactly when −f is convex. Strict convexity requires strict inequality whenever x≠y and 0<θ<1. Endpoints are excluded because equality necessarily holds there.

严格凸能保证什么？What does strict convexity guarantee?

在凸可行集上，严格凸函数至多有一个最小点。若两个不同点都最优，其中点仍可行，严格凸性却让中点费用更低，矛盾。这没有保证最小点存在。例如 eˣ 在 R 上严格凸，下确界为零但不取得。可行集不凸时唯一性也可能失败：x² 在 {−1,1} 上有两个最优点。On a convex feasible set, a strictly has at most one minimizer: two distinct minimizers would have a feasible midpoint with smaller cost. This does not establish existence; eˣ on R is strictly convex but has unattained infimum zero. A nonconvex feasible set can also defeat uniqueness: x² has two minimizers on {−1,1}.

以后为了把约束并入目标，会在域外令函数为 +∞。集合 C 的 δC 在 C 内为零、外为 +∞；它凸当且仅当 C 凸。这与概率论中取 0、1 的示性函数用途不同，此处必须看清定义。Constraints can be absorbed into an objective by assigning +∞ outside the domain. The convex indicator δC equals zero on C and +∞ outside; it is convex exactly when C is convex. This differs from a probability indicator taking values zero and one.

这是扩展值约定：+∞ 表示该输入不允许，后文处理共同定义域和时都会沿用。它不表示某个实际方案产生了可以参与普通减法的无限费用。This is an extended-value convention: +∞ marks an input as disallowed, used later for shared domains and . It is not an ordinary numeric cost permitting unrestricted subtraction.

练习Exercise

证明 x² 严格凸，不使用导数。Prove strict convexity of x² without derivatives.

提示Hint

计算右边减左边，尝试配成平方。Subtract the left side from the right and factor a square.

解答与核对Solution and check

当 x≠y 且 0<θ<1，右边严格正，所以满足严格凸定义。For x≠y and 0<θ<1 the difference is positive, establishing strict convexity.

4.2 一阶判据：切线是全局下界4.2 First-order criterion: tangent lower bounds

用定义直接展开平方很容易，但复杂函数未必方便。若函数可微，可以改问：在某点的线性近似是否压在整个图像下方？对开放凸域 D 上的可微函数，凸性等价于The definition works easily for squares but can be awkward for other functions. For a differentiable function, ask whether its local linear approximation lies below the whole graph. On an open convex domain D, convexity is equivalent to

右边固定在 x 处取梯度，却对所有 y 给下界。以 f=x²、x=1 为例，切线是 2y−1，差为 y²−(2y−1)=(y−1)²≥0。一般可微函数只有局部一阶近似，凸性才把它提升为全局下界。The gradient is fixed at x, yet gives a bound for every y. For f=x² at x=1, the line is 2y−1 and the gap is (y−1)²≥0. Differentiability alone gives a local approximation; convexity makes it a global bound.

为什么两种条件等价？Why are the conditions equivalent?

先假设凸。令 z=x+θ(y−x)，由定义 f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)。移项、除以 θ>0，再令 θ↓0，可微性把左边变成方向导数：Assume convexity. Let z=x+θ(y−x); then f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y). Rearrange, divide by θ>0 and let θ decrease to zero. Differentiability identifies the directional derivative:

反向假设全局下界成立。在 z=(1−θ)x+θy 处分别对 x、y 应用它，再乘 1−θ、θ 相加。梯度项消去，因为 (1−θ)(x−z)+θ(y−z)=0，于是 f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)，正是凸性。Conversely assume the lower-bound inequality. Apply it at z=(1−θ)x+θy with endpoints x,y. Weight the inequalities by 1−θ and θ and add. The gradient terms cancel since (1−θ)(x−z)+θ(y−z)=0, leaving exactly the convexity inequality.

因此在无约束的开放域中，若凸函数有 ∇f(x*)=0，则 x* 全局最优。非凸函数的驻点没有这个保证。带约束时梯度不必为零：例如在 [1,∞) 上最小化 x²，最优点 1 的导数为 2。Thus a zero gradient of a convex function at an interior unconstrained point guarantees a global minimum. Nonconvex stationary points lack that guarantee. With constraints the gradient need not vanish: x² on [1,∞) is minimized at one with derivative two.

补充阅读 · 不可微时的下界Further reading · Lower bounds without differentiability

若 f 不可微，仍可能有向量 g 满足 f(y)≥f(x)+gᵀ(y−x) 对所有 y 成立，称 g 为 x 处的。例如 |x| 在零点的所有 g∈[−1,1] 都给出这样的下界。次梯度不是把不存在的导数随意补一个值，而是直接由全局不等式定义。At a nondifferentiable point, a vector g satisfying f(y)≥f(x)+gᵀ(y−x) for every y is a . For |x| at zero every g∈[−1,1] works. A subgradient is defined by a global inequality, not by arbitrarily filling in a missing derivative.

练习Exercise

f=x³ 在零点导数为零，为什么不能据此判定全局最小？Why does the zero derivative of x³ at zero not imply a global minimum?

提示Hint

检查全局切线下界是否成立。Test the proposed global tangent lower bound.

解答与核对Solution and check

零点切线为零，但 y<0 时 y³<0，函数位于切线下方，违背凸函数的一阶判据。x³ 在整个 R 上也不凸。The tangent is zero, but y³<0 for y<0, violating the global lower bound. The function is not convex on all of R.

4.3 二阶判据与基本算例4.3 Second-order tests and worked examples

一阶条件仍比较任意两点。若函数二阶连续可微，可进一步只检查每个点的局部曲率。在开放凸域 D 上，凸性等价于 Hessian 处处半正定。The first-order condition compares all point pairs. For continuously twice differentiable functions on an open convex domain D, a local curvature test suffices: convexity is equivalent to an everywhere PSD Hessian.

理由是沿任意线段设 φ(t)=f(x+t(y−x))，其二阶导为 (y−x)ᵀH(y−x)。若 H 半正定，φ″≥0，一元函数的斜率不减，满足凸性不等式，因此每条线段都满足定义。反向若 f 凸，小线段两端的平均费用不低于中点，除以步长平方并取极限，得到每个方向的二次型非负。On a segment let φ(t)=f(x+t(y−x)). Its second derivative is (y−x)ᵀH(y−x). PSD H makes φ″≥0, so the one-variable slope is nondecreasing and the convexity inequality holds on every segment. Conversely, convexity bounds midpoint values by endpoint averages; divide their symmetric difference by squared step length and take limits to obtain nonnegative curvature in every direction.

这里 z 是域内点，故足够小 h 的两端都在域内；中点凸性给差商非负，第二章的二阶展开给出它的极限。Since z is interior, both endpoints remain in the domain for small h. Midpoint convexity makes the difference quotient nonnegative; Chapter 2 second-order expansion identifies its limit.

三个一元函数，逐次求导Three one-variable functions, differentiated explicitly

先看 f(x)=eᵃˣ，a 为固定实数。每次求导都乘内层系数 a。二阶导非负，所以对所有 a 都凸；a=0 时为常数 1，仍凸，但非严格凸。For f(x)=eᵃˣ with fixed real a, each differentiation multiplies by a. The second derivative is nonnegative for every a. If a=0 the function is the convex constant one, not strictly convex.

负对数定义域为 (0,∞)，不能把零或负数混进判断。熵项 x log x 也先取正半轴，第一次求导使用乘积法则：For −log x use domain (0,∞); zero and negative inputs are excluded. For x log x use the same domain and the product rule for its first derivative:

两者在正半轴均严格凸。更一般地 xᵖ 在 x>0 上二阶导为 p(p−1)xᵖ⁻²，所以 p≤0 或 p≥1 时凸，0≤p≤1 时凹，端点为仿射或常数。这里的幂是标量幂，不能直接推广成矩阵幂判据。Both are strictly convex on the positive half-line. More generally xᵖ has second derivative p(p−1)xᵖ⁻², so it is convex for p≤0 or p≥1 and concave for 0≤p≤1, with affine or constant endpoint cases. This is a scalar-power result, not a matrix-power rule.

例：最小二乘不要求满秩才凸Example: least squares is convex without full rank

对任意 m×n 的 A 和 b∈Rᵐ，设 g(x)=‖Ax−b‖₂²。先展开，区分二次、一次和常数项，再求导：For arbitrary m×n matrix A and b∈Rᵐ, set g(x)=‖Ax−b‖₂². Expand into quadratic, linear and constant terms before differentiating:

任意 v 都有 vᵀ(2AᵀA)v=2‖Av‖₂²≥0，所以 g 凸。A 满列秩时非零 v 不会映到零，H 正定，因此严格凸；不满列秩时仍凸，只是在零空间方向上没有曲率。Every v gives vᵀ(2AᵀA)v=2‖Av‖₂²≥0, so g is convex. Full column rank makes this positive for nonzero v, giving strict convexity. Rank deficiency preserves convexity but leaves zero curvature in null directions.

H 处处正定是严格凸的充分条件，并非必要。例如 x⁴ 的导数 4x³ 严格递增，所以严格凸，但零点二阶导为零；不能由某点 Hessian 不正定就否定严格凸。An everywhere positive definite Hessian is sufficient, not necessary, for strict convexity. The strictly convex x⁴ has zero second derivative at zero. Failure of positive definiteness at one point does not disprove strict convexity.

练习Exercise

对 F(x₁,x₂)=(x₁+2x₂−1)²+4(x₁−x₂)² 求 Hessian 并判断严格凸。Find the Hessian of F(x₁,x₂)=(x₁+2x₂−1)²+4(x₁−x₂)² and test strict convexity.

提示Hint

把目标写成最小二乘，A 的两行为 (1,2)、(2,−2)。Use least squares with rows (1,2) and (2,−2).

关键步骤Key steps

把两项写成矩阵A的两行，Hessian为2AᵀA。判断严格凸时检查Av=0是否只允许零向量。Write the two squares as rows of A, giving Hessian 2AᵀA. For strict convexity test whether Av=0 permits only the zero vector.

解答与核对Solution and check

A 可逆，所以 Av=0 只允许 v=0，二次型对非零 v 为正，F 严格凸。A is invertible, so Av=0 only for v=0. The Hessian quadratic form is positive for nonzero v and F is strictly convex.

练习Exercise

分别在各自实数定义域上，逐次求 e⁻²ˣ、−log(2x+1)、(x+1)log(x+1) 的两阶导数并判断凸性。Find the real domains and first two derivatives of e⁻²ˣ, −log(2x+1), and (x+1)log(x+1), then test convexity.

提示Hint

后两项分别先要求 2x+1>0、x+1>0，再用链式或乘积法则。Require positive logarithm arguments, then use the chain or product rule.

解答与核对Solution and check

三个域都是区间，二阶导在各域严格正，所以三者严格凸。若原指数参数 a=0，函数会变成常数，仍凸但非严格凸。Each domain is an interval and each second derivative is positive there, so all three are strictly convex. For the original exponential parameter a=0 the function is constant, convex but not strictly convex.

练习Exercise

g(x)=(x₁+2x₂−1)² 是否凸、严格凸？它与上面的两平方和有什么区别？Is g(x)=(x₁+2x₂−1)² convex or strictly convex? How does it differ from the two-square example?

提示Hint

写出秩为1的 Hessian，找一个非零零方向。Form the rank-one Hessian and find a nonzero null direction.

解答与核对Solution and check

Hessian 半正定，所以凸；所有满足 x₁+2x₂=1 的点费用都为0，因此有多个最小点，在 R² 上不严格凸。The Hessian is PSD, so g is convex. All points with x₁+2x₂=1 attain zero, giving multiple minimizers and disproving strict convexity on R².

4.6 Jensen 不等式：从两点到有限点4.6 Jensen inequality: from two points to many

凸函数定义只写两点，但平均费用常涉及许多个情形。给定非负权重 θᵢ、总和为 1，把同样的比较扩展到任意有限点数：The convexity definition uses two points, while average costs may involve many scenarios. For nonnegative weights summing to one, extends the same comparison to any finite number of inputs:

输入 xᵢ 都在凸定义域 D 中。有限凸组合仍在 D，已由第三章分组法说明，因此左边的函数值有定义。下面也用分组法证明不等式本身。All xᵢ lie in the convex domain D. Chapter 3 grouping shows that their finite convex combination remains in D, so the left side is defined. The same grouping proves the inequality.

先看三个权重 (1/2,1/3,1/6)。前两项总重 5/6，除以总重后变为 3/5、2/5。令 y=(3/5)x₁+(2/5)x₂，再把原混合写成 (5/6)y+(1/6)x₃。连续两次使用两点凸性：For weights (1/2,1/3,1/6), the first two total 5/6; normalized, they become 3/5 and 2/5. Set y=(3/5)x₁+(2/5)x₂ and write the original mixture as (5/6)y+(1/6)x₃. Apply two-point convexity twice:

第一步比较 y 与 x₃，第二步再展开 y。比如 f=x²，x₁=0、x₂=3、x₃=6，平均输入为 2，左边 4，右边 9；这个算例核对了权重运算。The first step compares y with x₃; the second expands y. For f=x² and inputs 0,3,6, the average input is two and the inequality is 4≤9, checking the weight arithmetic.

归纳到任意有限项Induction to any finite number

k=1 是等式，k=2 是定义。假设 k−1 项已成立，考虑 k 项。记 t=θₖ。若 t=1，其余权重全零，立即得到等式。若 t<1，令 y=Σᵢ<k θᵢxᵢ/(1−t)，这些归一化权重非负且和为 1，所以 y∈D。For k=1 equality holds; k=2 is the definition. Assume the claim for k−1 terms. For k terms write t=θₖ. If t=1, all other weights vanish and equality holds. If t<1, set y=Σᵢ<k θᵢxᵢ/(1−t). Its normalized weights sum to one, so y∈D.

最后一步对 y 使用归纳假设，乘回 1−t 后恢复原权重。θᵢ=0 不会影响求和；唯一可能的零分母 1−t 已先单独处理。期望版 E[f(X)]≥f(E[X]) 是进一步的积分推广，需要期望存在等条件，不能只凭有限归纳自动断言所有无限情形。The last step applies induction to y and multiplies back by 1−t, restoring the weights. Zero weights cause no difficulty; the possible zero denominator was separated first. The expectation version is an integral extension requiring existence assumptions, not an automatic consequence for arbitrary infinite mixtures.

6 · 锥与自对偶6 · Cones and self-duality

3.7 正常锥与广义不等式3.7 Proper cones and generalized inequalities

实数可以比较大小，但向量的某些分量更小、另一些更大时，怎样比较？一种自然选择是先规定哪些差向量表示“非负”。给定锥 K，若 y−x∈K，就记 x⪯Ky。例如 K 为非负正交象限时，它表示每个坐标分别不大于。Real numbers have an order, but vectors can improve in one component and worsen in another. Specify which difference vectors count as nonnegative. For a cone K, write x⪯Ky when y−x∈K. The nonnegative orthant gives componentwise comparison.

为了让这个比较稳定而有意义，课件使用（proper cone）：它是闭、凸、内部非空且尖的锥。凸锥的加法封闭保证传递性，尖性 K∩(−K)={0} 保证若两边互相不大于就必须相等；闭性保证极限下不丢失不等式，非空内部则提供严格比较的方向。The slides use proper cones: closed, convex, with nonempty interior and pointed, K∩(−K)={0}. Closure under addition gives transitivity; gives antisymmetry. Closedness preserves comparisons under limits, while a nonempty interior provides strict comparison directions.

例如 x⪯Ky、y⪯Kz 时，两个差向量在 K 中，相加得到 z−x∈K，所以 x⪯Kz。严格锥序写 x≺Ky，定义为 y−x∈int K；它通常比“⪯ 且不相等”更强，不能混用。If x⪯Ky and y⪯Kz, add the two differences in K to obtain z−x∈K. Strict cone order x≺Ky means y−x∈int K; it is generally stronger than x⪯Ky with x≠y.

例：二阶锥逐项检查Example: checking the second-order cone

把一个长度和一个标量比较，定义在 Rⁿ×R 中。t 可以理解为允许的长度上限，必须不小于 ‖x‖₂：The compares a vector length with a scalar in Rⁿ×R. Think of t as an allowance that must be at least ‖x‖₂:

先证缩放与凸性。非负缩放时长度与 t 同倍变化，仍满足约束。两个锥内点的凸组合满足下面的三角不等式，因此凸：For nonnegative scaling, both length and t scale together. For two feasible points, the triangle inequality proves feasibility of their convex combination:

再证闭性。若 (xₖ,tₖ)∈K 且趋于 (x,t)，由三角不等式 ‖x‖₂≤‖x−xₖ‖₂+‖xₖ‖₂≤‖x−xₖ‖₂+tₖ。令 k→∞，得到 ‖x‖₂≤t，所以极限仍在 K。For closedness, let (xₖ,tₖ) in K converge to (x,t). The triangle inequality gives ‖x‖₂≤‖x−xₖ‖₂+‖xₖ‖₂≤‖x−xₖ‖₂+tₖ. Passing to the limit gives ‖x‖₂≤t, so the limit stays in K.

内部非空可以直接放入一个环境空间的球：以 (0,1) 为中心、半径 1/2。球内有 ‖x‖₂<1/2 且 |t−1|<1/2，所以 t>1/2>‖x‖₂。最后若 (x,t) 与 (−x,−t) 都在 K，则 ‖x‖₂≤t 且 ‖x‖₂≤−t，只能 t=0、x=0，故锥尖。四项性质全部验证，K 是正常锥。An ambient Euclidean ball of radius one half centered at (0,1) lies inside K: its points have ‖x‖₂<1/2 and t>1/2. Finally, if both (x,t) and (−x,−t) are in K, then ‖x‖₂≤t and ‖x‖₂≤−t force x=0,t=0. Thus K is pointed. All four properties hold.

若另有 ‖z−y‖₂≤r−s，则 ‖z−x‖₂≤‖z−y‖₂+‖y−x‖₂≤r−t，正是 (x,t)⪯K(z,r)。If also ‖z−y‖₂≤r−s, then ‖z−x‖₂≤‖z−y‖₂+‖y−x‖₂≤r−t, which is (x,t)⪯K(z,r).

N(x)=max(|x₁|,2|x₂|) 是可逆线性变换后的 ℓ∞ 范数；用 N(x)≤2‖x‖₂ 控制球。N(x)=max(|x₁|,2|x₂|) is ℓ∞ after an invertible linear map; use N(x)≤2‖x‖₂.

解答与核对Solution and check

N 是范数，所以非负缩放和三角不等式证明 H 是凸锥。若 (xₖ,tₖ)→(x,t)，则 N(x)≤N(x−xₖ)+tₖ≤2‖x−xₖ‖₂+tₖ，取极限得到 N(x)≤t，故闭。As a norm, N gives conic scaling and convexity via its triangle inequality. If (xₖ,tₖ)→(x,t), then N(x)≤N(x−xₖ)+tₖ≤2‖x−xₖ‖₂+tₖ; taking limits proves closedness.

环境球半径可取1/4：球内 ‖x‖₂<1/4、t>3/4，所以 N(x)<1/2<t。若 (x,t) 与 (−x,−t) 都在 H，非负的 N(x) 同时不超过 t 和 −t，只能 t=0、x=0，故尖。内部非空、闭、凸、尖全部验证。Use ambient radius 1/4: inside it, ‖x‖₂<1/4 and t>3/4, so N(x)<1/2<t. If both signs belong to H, N(x)≤t and N(x)≤−t force t=0,x=0. This establishes nonempty interior, closedness, convexity and pointedness.

3.11 对偶锥：哪些评分总是非负3.11 Dual cones: scores nonnegative on a cone

对一个给定锥 K，问哪些系数 y 能让所有 x∈K 都有 yᵀx≥0。这些 y 组成 K*。它与对偶范数不同：这里不限制单位长度，也不求最大值，只要求对整个锥内所有点都通过非负测试。For a given cone K, ask which coefficients y give yᵀx≥0 for every x∈K. They form the K*. Unlike a dual norm, this is a set defined by nonnegative tests, without a unit-length restriction or maximization.

每个固定 x 给一个闭半空间，因此 K* 是闭凸锥。非负正交象限的对偶仍是自己：非负坐标内积非负；若 y 某项负，用该坐标单位向量测试就失败。一个子空间的对偶是它的正交补，因为 x 与 −x 同时可选，内积只能为零。Each fixed x defines a closed halfspace, so K* is a closed convex cone. The nonnegative orthant is self-dual: nonnegative coordinates pair nonnegatively, while a negative coordinate is exposed by its coordinate unit vector. A subspace has dual equal to its orthogonal complement, since both x and −x are allowed.

二阶锥为何自对偶？Why is the second-order cone self-dual?

对 K={(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}，内积采用 yᵀx+st。证明 K*=K 必须两向进行。先取 (y,s)∈K，即 ‖y‖₂≤s，对任意 (x,t)∈K，For K={(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}, use inner product yᵀx+st. Prove both inclusions. If (y,s)∈K, then for every (x,t)∈K,

这里 t≥0。因此 K⊆K*。反向设 (y,s)∈K*，先用锥内点 (0,1) 测试，得 s≥0，排除负的 s。若 y≠0，再用 (−y/‖y‖₂,1) 测试：Here t≥0, proving K⊆K*. Conversely take (y,s)∈K*. Testing (0,1) gives s≥0. If y≠0, test (−y/‖y‖₂,1):

于是 s≥‖y‖₂，故该点属于 K。y=0 时，先得到的 s≥0 已给出同样结论，无须除以零。两向合并即自对偶。Thus s≥‖y‖₂, giving membership in K. For y=0 the initial s≥0 already suffices, without dividing by zero. Both inclusions prove self-duality.

y=0 时 ‖y‖₂=0≤s，直接符合 K 的定义；该分支既不需要构造单位方向，也不需要除以 ‖y‖₂。If y=0, then ‖y‖₂=0≤s directly satisfies the definition of K; no unit direction or division by ‖y‖₂ is needed.

补充阅读 · 一般范数锥与矩阵锥Further reading · General norm cones and matrix cones

将欧氏范数换成任意范数 N，锥 K={(x,t):N(x)≤t} 的对偶是 {(y,s):N*(y)≤s}。正向用第二章的 |yᵀx|≤N*(y)N(x)；反向取 N(x)=1 且使 yᵀx=−N*(y) 的方向测试，y=0 时另取 (0,1)。For any norm N, the dual of K={(x,t):N(x)≤t} is {(y,s):N*(y)≤s}. Sufficiency uses |yᵀx|≤N*(y)N(x); necessity tests a unit vector attaining the negative dual score, with (0,1) handling y=0.

半正定锥在迹内积下也自对偶。若 X,Y⪰0，tr(XY)=tr(X½YX½)≥0，因为后者半正定，迹为非负特征值之和。反向若对称 Y 不是半正定，存在 v 使 vᵀYv<0，取 X=vvᵀ⪰0 就有 tr(XY)<0。The PSD cone is also self-dual under trace inner product. For X,Y PSD, tr(XY)=tr(X½YX½)≥0, the trace of a PSD matrix. Conversely a symmetric non-PSD Y has vᵀYv<0; X=vvᵀ is PSD and gives tr(XY)<0.

补充阅读 · 极集与对偶锥的区别Further reading · Polar sets versus dual cones

非空集合 C 的定义为 C°={y:yᵀx≤1 对所有 x∈C}。它限制线性评分的上界为1；对偶锥则要求所有评分非负。若 C 是范数单位球，极集恰是相应对偶范数的单位球，因为这个上界就是对偶范数值。For nonempty C, the polar is C°={y:yᵀx≤1 for every x∈C}. It bounds scores above by one, whereas a dual cone requires nonnegative scores. The polar of a norm unit ball is the dual-norm unit ball, since the maximum score is the dual norm.

Set t=1 and xᵢ=−sgn(yᵢ), using zero at zero entries. Then ‖x‖∞≤1 and the pairing is s−Σ|yᵢ|≥0. Thus s≥‖y‖₁; for y=0 the first test already suffices.

3.12 对偶评分与 Pareto 前沿3.12 Dual scores and Pareto frontiers

现在把锥序与线性评分联系起来。如果 y−x∈K，那么每个 w∈K* 都满足 wᵀx≤wᵀy。所以锥序比较包含一整族线性评分的比较。若 K 闭且凸，分离定理还保证反向成立：若差向量不在 K，就能找到某个对偶评分揭示它。Cone order implies comparisons of linear scores: y−x∈K gives wᵀx≤wᵀy for every w∈K*. For a closed convex cone the converse follows from separation: a difference outside K is exposed by some dual score.

因此 x∈S 是最小元素，等价于它同时最小化每个对偶线性评分。只最小化某一个评分通常不足以得到最小元素，因为该评分可能忽略某些方向。Thus x∈S is a minimum exactly when it minimizes every dual linear score. Minimizing just one score generally does not establish a minimum, since that score may ignore directions.

多目标问题怎样选择一个方案？Selecting a plan with multiple objectives

对费用、误差等多目标，常把它们加权成一个标量再最小化。若所有权重严格正，最优点必极小：倘若另有点各项都不大于它，且至少一项严格更小，正加权和就会严格下降，矛盾。A common approach is minimizing a weighted sum of cost, error and other objectives. With every weight strictly positive, any minimizer is minimal: a point no worse in every coordinate and strictly better in one would have a strictly smaller weighted score.

若某个权重为零，这个保证会减弱。例如 S={(1,1),(1,2)}、w=(1,0)，两点得分相同，较差的 (1,2) 也能成为加权最优点。所有极小目标点组成 ，它描述指标之间无法同时改善的权衡。If a weight is zero, the guarantee weakens. For S={(1,1),(1,2)} and w=(1,0), both scores tie, so even dominated (1,2) is a minimizer. Minimal objective vectors form the , describing tradeoffs that cannot be improved simultaneously.

补充阅读 · 权重法的范围Further reading · Limits of weighted sums

对正常锥，内点权重 w∈int K* 对每个非零 d∈K 都有 wᵀd>0，因此同样保证加权最优点极小。非零边界权重一般只保证弱极小。凸目标集合的极小点可由某个非零非负权重支撑，但不一定由严格正权重取得。非凸目标集合甚至可能有加权和找不到的极小点。For a proper cone, interior weights w∈int K* have wᵀd>0 for every nonzero d∈K, giving minimal minimizers. Nonzero boundary weights generally guarantee only weak minimality. Minimal points of convex objective sets can have supporting nonzero nonnegative weights, but not necessarily strictly positive ones. Nonconvex sets can have minimal points not found by weighted sums.

例如凸集 S={(x,y):0≤x≤1，y≥(1−x)²} 的 (1,0) 极小。若两个权重都正，从 (1,0) 改成 (1−ε,ε²)，费用减少 w₁ε，误差费用只增加 w₂ε²；足够小 ε 下总分下降，所以该点不能由严格正权重最小化。For convex S={(x,y):0≤x≤1, y≥(1−x)²}, point (1,0) is minimal. With both weights positive, moving to (1−ε,ε²) reduces the score by w₁ε while adding only w₂ε², so small ε improves the score. Strictly positive weights cannot select that point.

练习Exercise

S={(1,4),(2,2),(4,1)}。权重 (1,1) 选哪一点？(3,1) 呢？For S={(1,4),(2,2),(4,1)}, which point is selected by weights (1,1)? By (3,1)?

提示Hint

逐点计算加权和，别把坐标分别取最小后拼成不存在的方案。Compute each weighted score; do not combine separate coordinate minima into an unavailable plan.

解答与核对Solution and check

(1,1) 的得分为 5、4、5，选 (2,2)；(3,1) 的得分为 7、8、13，选 (1,4)。两组权重都正，所以所选点均极小。Weights (1,1) give 5,4,5 and select (2,2). Weights (3,1) give 7,8,13 and select (1,4). Both weight vectors are positive, so both selected points are minimal.

01 · 把实际问题写成优化模型01 · Turn a decision into an optimization model

买两种食品，数量为 x₁、x₂，单价为 3、2，每份蛋白质为 2、1。要以最低费用获得至少 4 单位蛋白质，就最小化 3x₁+2x₂，约束 2x₁+x₂≥4、x₁,x₂≥0。数量是变量，其余是数据；允许小数份时，这是连续模型。Two foods have quantities x₁,x₂, prices 3,2 and protein contents 2,1 per serving. Minimize cost 3x₁+2x₂ subject to 2x₁+x₂≥4 and x₁,x₂≥0. Quantities are variables; the other numbers are data. Allowing fractional servings gives a continuous model.

先判断可行，再比较费用：(2,0) 费用为 6；(1,1) 虽只需 5，却不满足营养要求。记最优点为 x*，为 p*。本例由 3x₁+2x₂≥1.5(2x₁+x₂)≥6，知 (2,0) 最优。Check feasibility before cost: (2,0) costs 6; (1,1) costs 5 but fails the nutrition requirement. Write x* for an optimizer and p* for the . Since 3x₁+2x₂≥1.5(2x₁+x₂)≥6, (2,0) is optimal.

同一模板可描述拟合和投资：误差或风险作为目标，参数范围或收益要求作为约束。模型仍可能无解：可行集为空称不可行；目标可降至 −∞ 称无下界；在 x>0 上最小化 x，值为 0 却没有点取到它。The same template models fitting or investment: minimize error or risk under parameter or return constraints. An empty feasible set is infeasible; arbitrarily negative cost is unbounded below. Minimizing x over x>0 has value 0 but no point attaining it.

本例费用下界第一步用 x₂≥0：两边之差是 x₂/2；第二步用蛋白质约束。x=(2,0) 同时满足所有约束并使两步取等，这才将“下界”确认为“最优值”。The first cost bound uses x₂≥0: its gap is x₂/2. The second uses the protein constraint. Point (2,0) is feasible and attains equality in both steps, identifying the bound as the optimal value.

一般问题在可行集 C 上最小化 f₀。证明 x* 最优需要两件事：x*∈C，且所有 x∈C 都满足 f₀(x)≥f₀(x*)。上面的费用下界正好完成第二步。To prove x* minimizes f₀ on C, show x*∈C and f₀(x)≥f₀(x*) for every x∈C. The cost bound above establishes the second requirement.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把“至少 4 单位蛋白质”改成“恰好 4 单位”，(0,5) 还可行吗？上述最优点会改变吗？Replace at least four protein units by exactly four. Is (0,5) still feasible? Does the optimizer change?

思路提示Hint

把候选点代入新的等式约束；原最优点只有仍满足等式才可保留。Substitute into the new equality; an old optimizer remains eligible only if it satisfies it.

关键步骤Key steps

把“至少4”改写为“等于4”，先检查 (0,5) 是否恰好提供4；再把原最优点代回新等式。Replace “at least four” by equality. Check whether (0,5) supplies exactly four, then substitute the previous optimizer into the equality.

展开核对Check the answer

(0,5) 不满足等式。原下界证明仍适用，(2,0) 仍可行并取得 6，因此最优值和最优点不变。The point (0,5) violates the equality. The same lower bound applies, and (2,0) remains feasible and attains six, so the optimal value and optimizer stay the same.

最优值是可行目标值的下确界，即最大下界。存在有限下确界仍可能没有最优点，须另查是否取得。The optimal value is the infimum of feasible costs: their greatest lower bound. A finite infimum need not be attained.

02 · 最小二乘：怎样选出一个最佳预测02 · Least squares: how to choose one best prediction

测量得到 1、2、6，希望用同一个数 x 作为预测。三项残差为 x−1、x−2、x−6，即预测值减观测值。直接相加会让正负误差抵消：x=3 时，残差为 2、1、−3，和为零，实际仍有偏差。Readings are 1,2,6, and we want one common prediction x. Residuals x−1,x−2,x−6 are prediction minus observation. Their signed sum can hide discrepancies: at x=3, residuals 2,1,−3 sum to zero despite nonzero errors.

最小二乘先平方再相加，以 F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)² 比较候选值。平方使两种符号都贡献非负代价，并更重地惩罚大偏差。这里假定三次观测同等重要，x 可取任意实数；换用绝对值会得到另一种模型。Least squares compares candidates by F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)². Squaring makes either sign contribute nonnegative cost and penalizes larger misses more heavily. The readings have equal importance and x may be any real number. Absolute-error scoring defines a different model.

例如 F(2)=17、F(3)=14，但试几个数还不能证明 3 最好。要比较全部实数，可把二次式配成平方：F(x)=3x²−18x+41=3(x−3)²+14。平方项非负，且仅在 x=3 时为零，所以最佳预测唯一为 3，最低平方和为 14。For example, F(2)=17 and F(3)=14, but testing candidates does not prove optimality. Complete the square to compare all real x: F(x)=3x²−18x+41=3(x−3)²+14. The squared term is nonnegative and vanishes only at 3. Thus 3 is the unique best prediction and 14 the minimum squared error.

最低分仍大于零，因为一个预测无法同时等于三个不同读数。“最佳”依据的是选定的计分规则，并不保证恢复未知真值。左图把预测 3 与数据比较，竖线表示残差大小；右图以候选 x 为横轴、F(x) 为纵轴，最低点是 (3,14)。Positive minimum error remains because one prediction cannot equal three different readings. Optimality is relative to the scoring rule and does not guarantee an unknown true value. In the left panel, vertical segments compare prediction 3 with the data. The right panel plots F against candidate x, with minimum (3,14).

观测很多时，可用矩阵收集同一运算。令列向量 b=(1,2,6)ᵀ、A=(1,1,1)ᵀ，则 Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ，Ax−b 收集全部残差。欧氏范数 ‖r‖₂ 是各分量平方和的平方根，因此 ‖Ax−b‖₂²=F(x)。上标 T 表示转置。For many observations, matrix notation collects the same operations. Let columns b=(1,2,6)ᵀ and A=(1,1,1)ᵀ. Then Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ and Ax−b contains the residuals. Euclidean norm ‖r‖₂ is the square root of the sum of squared components, so ‖Ax−b‖₂²=F(x). Superscript T denotes transpose.

本节只把矩阵记号当作收集三个相同预测的缩写。多参数求导放在第 33 节；首次自学先能解释残差、评分和配方证明即可。Here matrix notation only collects three identical predictions. Multiple-parameter differentiation is developed in unit 33. For a first reading, explain residuals, the score and the completed-square proof.

一般地，对 m≥1 个读数 bᵢ，记均值 b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m，其中 Σᵢ 表示从 i=1 到 m 求和。把 x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) 平方相加，得到 Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)²；交叉项 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=0，因为 Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0。For m≥1 readings bᵢ, let b̄=(Σᵢbᵢ)/m, where Σᵢ sums from 1 to m. Square x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ) and sum to obtain Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)². The cross term 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ) vanishes since Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0.

最后一项与 x 无关，第一项只在 x=b̄ 时取零，故最佳常数唯一等于均值。也可求导得 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ)=0；上述平方分解说明这个驻点确实全局最优。The last term is independent of x; the first vanishes only at x=b̄. Hence the mean is uniquely optimal. Differentiation also gives 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ)=0; the square decomposition proves that stationary point is globally optimal.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

用同样方法处理观测 0、2、4：先比较候选值 1、2、3，再把平方和配方。写清最佳选择和最低分各是什么。For readings 0,2,4, compare candidate constants 1,2,3, then complete the square. Distinguish the best constant from the minimum score.

思路提示Hint

先把三项误差平方相加，再围绕观测平均值配方。Sum the three squared errors and complete the square around their mean.

关键步骤Key steps

平方和为 c²+(c−2)²+(c−4)²=3(c−2)²+8。The squared error is c²+(c−2)²+(c−4)²=3(c−2)²+8.

展开核对Check the answer

候选值 1、2、3 的平方和分别为 11、8、11。全部候选的分数为 x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8，因此最佳常数为 2，最低平方误差总和为 8。比较候选只提供线索，配方给出对所有实数 x 的证明。The candidate scores are eleven, eight and eleven. For every real x, x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8. Thus the best constant is two and minimum score eight. Candidate comparisons suggest the result; completion of squares proves it for all real x.

补充阅读 · 进一步联系Further reading · Further connections

多参数模型用向量 x 给出预测 Ax。学完和矩阵求导后，可得到正规方程 Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0：残差与所有可调预测方向正交。本节它简化为 3x−9=0，仍给出 x=3。非零 h 若满足 Ah=0，x 与 x+h 预测相同，参数便可能不唯一。In a multiple-parameter model, vector x gives predictions Ax. Inner products and matrix differentiation yield Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0: the residual is orthogonal to adjustable prediction directions. Here it reduces to 3x−9=0 and again gives x=3. If a nonzero h satisfies Ah=0, x and x+h predict identically, allowing nonunique parameters.

03 · 线性规划与等价改写03 · Linear programming and equivalent formulations

的目标和约束均为仿射式，如 2x+3；“仿射”允许常数项。可行集由半空间、超平面的交组成。二维中把目标的平行等值线向费用降低的一侧移动，可以看出最优位置。Linear programs have affine objectives and constraints, such as 2x+3; affine expressions allow constants. Their feasible sets intersect halfspaces and s. In two dimensions, move parallel objective level lines toward lower cost to locate an optimum.

例如 min max(2x+1,−x+4)，引入 t，改成 min t，约束 t≥2x+1、t≥−x+4。固定 x 时最小可行 t 恰为最大项。两线交于 (1,3)；x<1 时第二项>3，x>1 时第一项>3，故最优值为 3。For min max(2x+1,−x+4), introduce t and minimize t subject to both affine expressions being at most t. For fixed x, the smallest feasible t equals their . The lines meet at (1,3); either side makes one expression exceed 3, proving optimality.

类似地，|u|≤t 等价于 −t≤u≤t，最小化最坏残差时，就约束每个 −t≤(Ax−b)ᵢ≤t，再最小化 t。Likewise, |u|≤t means −t≤u≤t, giving an LP for worst residuals: minimize t subject to −t≤(Ax−b)ᵢ≤t for every i.

“最大项≤t”要求每一项都≤t，故约束应全部保留。若只约束其中一项，新模型就可能给原问题不能达到的费用。A maximum is at most t exactly when every term is at most t, so retain all constraints. Keeping just one may yield a cost unavailable in the original problem.

等价改写须验证两向：每个原变量 x 可配 t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ)，费用不变；每个新可行 (x,t) 都使原费用≤t。两向比较给出相同最优值。For equivalence, extend each original x with t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ) at unchanged cost. Conversely, each new feasible (x,t) has original cost≤t. Both comparisons establish equal optimal values.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把 minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| 写成线性规划，并找最优值。Write minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| as a linear program and find its value.

思路提示Hint

给两个绝对值各设一个上界变量，并分别用两条线性不等式约束。Introduce one upper-bound variable for each absolute value and constrain it by two linear inequalities.

关键步骤Key steps

设 u≥x−2、u≥2−x，v≥x+1、v≥−x−1，最小化 u+v；两绝对值之和至少为 |(x−2)−(x+1)|=3。Use u≥x−2, u≥2−x, v≥x+1, v≥−x−1 and minimize u+v. The absolute-value triangle inequality gives the lower bound three.

展开核对Check the answer

引入 u、v，最小化 u+v，约束 u≥±(x−2)、v≥±(x+1)。三角不等式给目标≥3；x∈[−1,2] 都达到 3。Introduce u and v, minimize u+v and impose u≥±(x−2), v≥±(x+1). The triangle inequality bounds the objective below by three, attained throughout [−1,2].

04 · 凸优化与灯光设计04 · Why convex optimization is useful

若可行方案 x、y 按 0≤θ≤1 混合后仍可行，可行集就是凸的；若混合费用≤两费用的加权平均，目标就是凸函数。这使局部最优能够推出全局最优，后面两讲将分别展开定义。A feasible set is convex if mixtures θx+(1−θ)y remain feasible for 0≤θ≤1. An objective is convex if its mixture cost is no greater than the weighted costs. These properties make local optimality imply global optimality; the next lectures develop the definitions.

照明设计的任务是：几盏灯的位置固定，调节每盏灯的功率，让若干测量点的亮度尽量接近指定值。我们要选的是灯的功率，测量点的位置以及灯到各点的影响已知。于是先建立“功率怎样决定亮度”的关系，再选择衡量偏差的目标函数。In illumination design, lamp positions are fixed. Choose each lamp power so that brightness at several measurement points approaches a target. Powers are decision variables; measurement locations and each lamp contribution are known. First model brightness from powers, then choose a deviation objective.

照明模型中，灯功率 pⱼ≥0，位置 i 的亮度 Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ，Aᵢⱼ 是已知贡献。目标亮度 Ides>0，令 uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides。课件最小化 maxᵢ|log uᵢ|；因 |log u|=log max(u,1/u)，可等价最小化 maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ)。Lamp powers pⱼ≥0 give intensity Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ, with known contributions Aᵢⱼ. For target Ides>0 set uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides. Since |log u|=log max(u,1/u), minimizing the worst log deviation is equivalent to minimizing maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ).

在 uᵢ>0 上，uᵢ 仿射、1/uᵢ 凸，取最大值仍凸，功率上下界也给凸约束。改写保留最优功率，目标值相差一个对数；改用平方误差则改变了模型。检查凸性时要同时核对定义域、组合规则和不等号方向。On uᵢ>0, uᵢ is affine and 1/uᵢ convex, so their maximum is convex; power bounds are convex constraints. The reformulation preserves optimal powers, with values related by a logarithm. Squared-error scoring changes the model. Check s, composition rules and inequality directions together.

例如一个位置亮度是目标的两倍或一半，|log u| 都为 log 2；所以此评分对过亮与过暗采用比例对称性。u=0 时 log 无定义，必须先限制每个 Iᵢ>0。log 严格递增且 maxᵢlog vᵢ=log maxᵢvᵢ，才保证改写保留最优功率。An intensity twice or half the target gives |log u|=log 2, expressing proportional symmetry. At u=0 the logarithm is undefined, so require every Iᵢ>0. Strictly increasing log and maxᵢlog vᵢ=log maxᵢvᵢ justify preservation of optimal powers.

若局部最优 x 有更好的可行 y，则任意小 θ>0 都给可行点 z=(1−θ)x+θy，且 f(z)≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)<f(x)。z 可任意接近 x，矛盾。因此局部最优必全局最优。If local optimum x had a better feasible y, then z=(1−θ)x+θy is feasible and f(z)<f(x) for arbitrarily small θ>0 by convexity. This contradicts local optimality, proving global optimality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

x²≤1、x²≥1 和 x²=1 分别定义什么集合？哪些是凸的？Which sets do x²≤1, x²≥1 and x²=1 define, and which are convex?

思路提示Hint

分别写出三个集合，再取 −1、1 检查中点 0 是否保留。Write the three sets and test whether they retain midpoint zero between −1 and one.

关键步骤Key steps

三个集合分别为 [−1,1]、(−∞,−1]∪[1,∞)、{−1,1}。对后两者，中点0都被排除。The sets are [−1,1], (−∞,−1]∪[1,∞), and {−1,1}. The last two exclude midpoint zero.

展开核对Check the answer

分别为 [−1,1]、两条外侧射线、{−1,1}。后两者含 −1、1 却不含中点 0，只有第一个集合凸。They are [−1,1], two outer rays and {−1,1}. The latter two contain −1 and 1 but exclude midpoint zero. Only the first is convex.

05 · 局部、全局与非凸问题中的凸优化05 · Local and global behavior in nonlinear problems

局部极小只与某个邻域内的可行点比较，全局极小则与全部可行点比较。一般非凸目标可能有多处谷底，下降方法到达一处后，远处仍可能更低。A local minimum compares nearby feasible points; a global minimum compares every feasible point. A nonconvex objective may have several valleys, so descent into one need not find the deepest.

例如 f(x)=(x²−1)²≥0，在 ±1 取零，故两点均全局最优。导数 4x(x²−1) 在 0 也为零，但 f(0)=1，向两侧稍移都会下降。导数为零称驻点，仍需判断它是否极小。For f(x)=(x²−1)²≥0, ±1 attain zero and are global minima. Its derivative 4x(x²−1) also vanishes at 0, but f(0)=1 and small moves either way lower it. A stationary point has zero derivative and need not be a minimum.

凸松弛先把难处理的非凸可行集放宽成一个包含它的凸集，再解决放宽后的问题。例如原约束 x∈{−1,1}，放宽为 −1≤x≤1。若目标为最小化 x²，原问题最小值是1，放宽后可选 x=0，最小值变为0。新增了选择，最小费用便可能更低；这个0是原最优值的下界，却不是原问题的可行解。A convex relaxation replaces a difficult nonconvex feasible set by a containing convex set. For example relax x∈{−1,1} to −1≤x≤1 while minimizing x². The original minimum is one; the relaxation allows x=0 with minimum zero. More choices can lower the minimum. Zero is a lower bound, but x=0 is not an original feasible solution.

补充阅读 · 一般下界的写法Further reading · The general lower-bound relation

用 C 表示原可行集、D 表示放宽后的集合，C⊆D。原目标 f 定义在 C 上，放宽目标 g 定义在 D 上；若原可行点处总有 g(x)≤f(x)，则下面两个比较依次来自扩大选择集、逐点压低目标。只放宽约束时，目标保持相同。Let C be the original feasible set and D its relaxation, C⊆D. Let f be the original cost on C and g a cost on D satisfying g(x)≤f(x) on C. The two comparisons below follow from enlarging the choice set and lowering costs pointwise. A constraint-only relaxation keeps the same cost.

继续分析前面的 f(x)=(x²−1)²。我们已由一阶导数找到驻点 −1、0、1，现在用二阶导数判断它们附近的弯曲方向：二阶导正给严格局部极小，负给严格局部极大。先求导再逐点代入：Continue with f(x)=(x²−1)². The first derivative gave stationary points −1,0,1. We now use the second derivative to classify their local curvature: positive gives a strict local minimum and negative a strict local maximum. Differentiate and evaluate:

因此 ±1 为严格局部极小、0 为严格局部极大。全局结论另外由 f(x)≥0 且 f(±1)=0 得到；局部二阶判断本身没有比较远处所有点。Thus ±1 are strict local minima and zero a strict local maximum. Global optimality follows separately from f(x)≥0 and f(±1)=0; the local second-derivative test does not compare all distant points.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x³ 在 x=0 的导数为零。它是吗？The derivative of f(x)=x³ vanishes at zero. Is zero a local minimum?

思路提示Hint

局部极小要求附近所有点费用不低于零点；试取一个任意小的负输入。A local minimum requires nearby values no smaller than the value at zero; test a small negative input.

关键步骤Key steps

任意 ε>0 都有 f(−ε)=−ε³<0=f(0)，而 −ε 可以任意接近0。For every ε>0, f(−ε)=−ε³<0=f(0), with −ε arbitrarily close to zero.

展开核对Check the answer

任意小的负 x 都有 x³<0，因此 0 不是局部极小点。Arbitrarily small negative x satisfy x³<0, so zero is not a local minimum.

特殊非凸问题也可能易解；凸性本身则不保证最优点存在或计算稳定。Special nonconvex problems can be easy. Convexity alone guarantees neither attainment nor numerical stability.

2.12 奇异值分解与伪逆2.12 Singular values and the pseudoinverse

特征分解给对称方阵找到简单坐标，但实际矩阵可能是矩形，也可能不对称。我们希望在输入和输出两边分别换一组正交坐标，使中间只剩各方向的缩放。这就是，简称 SVD。Eigen-decomposition provides simple coordinates for symmetric square matrices, but practical matrices may be rectangular or nonsymmetric. Change orthonormal coordinates separately on input and output so that only directional scalings remain in between. This is singular value decomposition, SVD.

完整分解中 U 为 m×m、V 为 n×n，Σ 为 m×n 的矩形对角矩阵。其非负对角元叫奇异值，通常从大到小排列。输入先经 Vᵀ 换坐标，再由 Σ 缩放，最后经 U 换到输出坐标。正交变换保持欧氏长度，因此最大奇异值 σ₁ 就是诱导欧氏范数；零矩阵的范数为零。In the full decomposition U is m×m, V is n×n, and Σ is rectangular diagonal m×n. Its nonnegative diagonal entries are singular values, usually in descending order. Vᵀ changes input coordinates, Σ scales, and U changes to output coordinates. Orthogonal maps preserve Euclidean length, so the largest singular value σ₁ is the induced Euclidean norm; the zero matrix has norm zero.

长度保持可以直接核对：若 QᵀQ=I，则 ‖Qy‖₂²=yᵀQᵀQy=yᵀy。SVD 的存在也能由已学的对称特征分解构造出来，下面给出关键步骤。Length preservation follows directly: if QᵀQ=I, then ‖Qy‖₂²=yᵀQᵀQy=yᵀy. The symmetric eigen-decomposition already studied also constructs an SVD; the key steps follow.

AᵀA 对称半正定，因为 vᵀAᵀAv=‖Av‖₂²≥0。将它的正交单位特征向量记为 vᵢ，特征值为 λᵢ，令 σᵢ=√λᵢ。对正的 σᵢ 定义 uᵢ=Avᵢ/σᵢ；下面的内积验证这些输出方向也正交且长为 1。AᵀA is symmetric PSD because vᵀAᵀAv=‖Av‖₂²≥0. Let its orthonormal eigenvectors be vᵢ, eigenvalues λᵢ, and set σᵢ=√λᵢ. For positive σᵢ define uᵢ=Avᵢ/σᵢ. Their inner products below show that these output directions are orthonormal too.

λᵢ=0 时 Avᵢ=0。把已有 uᵢ 补成输出空间的一组正交单位基，就得到 U；V 由全部 vᵢ 构成。对每个基向量都成立 Avᵢ=σᵢuᵢ（零方向输出为零），所以 A=UΣVᵀ。这说明分解如何从特征分解得到。If λᵢ=0 then Avᵢ=0. Complete the existing uᵢ to an orthonormal output basis to obtain U; all vᵢ form V. The relation Avᵢ=σᵢuᵢ holds on every nonzero direction, with zero output on null directions, proving A=UΣVᵀ. This constructs the SVD from eigen-decomposition.

正奇异值个数 r≤min(m,n)，已有的 r 个 uᵢ 在 m 维空间中正交，所以还可以补 m−r 个方向。补全后 U、V 都是方阵；矩形和零方向全部由 Σ 的形状与零项承担。The number r of positive singular values is at most min(m,n). The r orthonormal uᵢ in m dimensions can therefore be extended by m−r directions. U and V become square matrices; the rectangular shape and zero directions are represented in Σ.

最后一个等式来自 AᵀA=VΣᵀΣVᵀ，故其特征值是奇异值的平方。对对称方阵，奇异值是特征值的绝对值；只有半正定时才能直接把最大特征值当作谱范数。The last equality follows from AᵀA=VΣᵀΣVᵀ, whose eigenvalues are squared singular values. For a symmetric matrix, singular values are absolute eigenvalues; the largest eigenvalue equals the spectral norm directly when the matrix is PSD.

无法求逆时，怎样选择一个解？Choosing a solution when inversion is unavailable

考虑最小二乘 。换坐标 y=Vᵀx、c=Uᵀb 后，目标成为 。每个非零奇异方向都有独立的一元平方项，可选 yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ 使其为零；无法到达的输出分量只能留下残差；输入零方向则不影响拟合。For least squares , set y=Vᵀx and c=Uᵀb to obtain . Every nonzero singular direction gives a separate square minimized by yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ. Unreachable output components remain as residual; input null directions do not affect the fit.

为了在所有最小二乘解中再选欧氏长度最小者，把不影响拟合的输入坐标取零。这给出：先把 Σ 转成 n×m 的形状，对非零奇异值取倒数，零仍留零，所得矩阵记为 Σ†。To select the shortest Euclidean solution among all least-squares minimizers, set the free input coordinates to zero. This defines the : form an n×m matrix Σ† by reciprocating the nonzero singular values and leaving zero entries zero.

例如 A=diag(2,0)、b=(4,3)，目标为 (2x₁−4)²+9。所有 (2,t) 都使残差平方最小；其中最短者为 (2,0)，正是 A†b，残差 Ax−b=(0,−3)。伪逆在无解时给最小二乘解，在有多个最小二乘解时再选最短者。For A=diag(2,0), b=(4,3), the objective is (2x₁−4)²+9. Every (2,t) minimizes it; the shortest is (2,0)=A†b, with residual Ax−b=(0,−3). The pseudoinverse gives a least-squares solution when exact solution is impossible, and selects the shortest among multiple least-squares solutions.

补充阅读 · 小奇异值与数值敏感性Further reading · Small singular values and sensitivity

若非零 σᵢ 很小，除以它会放大对应的观测误差。例如 σᵢ=0.001，输出误差 0.01 会变成该输入坐标的误差 10。因此实际计算不宜只看矩阵在数学上是否可逆；截断小奇异值或加正则化可以减少放大，但也改变拟合结果。数值秩需要说明容差。A small nonzero σᵢ magnifies measurement errors when inverted. If σᵢ=0.001, an output error 0.01 becomes an input-coordinate error ten. Exact invertibility alone is insufficient for reliable computation. Truncation or regularization reduces amplification but changes the fit; numerical rank needs a stated tolerance.

提示Hint

解答与核对Solution and check

输出为 (6,2,0)，第三个残差 −5 无法消除。任意 (2,2,t) 都最小化残差，t=0 使长度最小。The output is (6,2,0), leaving unavoidable third residual −5. Every (2,2,t) minimizes the residual; t=0 minimizes length.

补充阅读 · SVD读出Frobenius与核范数Further reading · Frobenius and nuclear norms from SVD

正交坐标不改变全部元素平方和，故 Frobenius 范数等于奇异值平方和的平方根。则定义为奇异值之和。diag(3,2) 的两者分别为 √13、5，而谱范数为最大奇异值 3。Orthonormal coordinate changes preserve the sum of squared entries, so the Frobenius norm is the square root of the sum of squared singular values. The is defined as their sum. For diag(3,2), these values are √13 and five, while the spectral norm is three.

在矩阵迹内积下，谱范数与核范数互为对偶，这是矩阵范数的进一步结论（教材附录A.1.6）。本章的向量对偶范数和作业1所需证明不依赖这条矩阵对偶结论。Under the trace inner product, spectral and nuclear norms are dual, a further matrix-norm result in textbook Appendix A.1.6. The vector dual-norm proofs required here do not depend on it.
