2.13 Schur 补：分块矩阵中的配方2.13 Schur complements: completing a block square

判断一个大矩阵是否半正定，直接求全部特征值有时并不方便。如果一个对角块已经正定，可以仿照一元二次式配方，先消去一组变量，再判断剩下的部分。先从两个变量看起。Computing every eigenvalue may be inconvenient for a large matrix. If one diagonal block is positive definite, complete a square to eliminate one group of variables and test the remainder. Start with two variables.

若 c≥1/2，两项都非负，矩阵半正定。若 c<1/2，取 u=−v/2 且 v≠0，第一项为零，第二项为负，矩阵就不半正定。因此这个矩阵半正定恰好要求 c≥1/2，判断只剩一个数。If c≥1/2, both terms are nonnegative and the matrix is PSD. If c<1/2, set u=−v/2 with v≠0 to make the first term zero and the second negative. Thus PSD is equivalent to c≥1/2: only one scalar remains to test.

推广到对称分块矩阵 M。设 A 为 k×k 正定，B 为 k×l，C 为 l×l 对称，u、v 分别为 k、l 维向量。矩阵乘法给二次型 uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀCv。将第一组变量配成平方：For symmetric block matrix M, let A be k×k positive definite, B be k×l, C be l×l symmetric, with vectors u,v of sizes k,l. Its quadratic form is uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀCv. Complete the square in u:

A 正定意味着所有特征值都正，所以没有非零零空间向量，A⁻¹ 存在。下面的配方因此合法；展开第一项得到 uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀBᵀA⁻¹Bv，最后一项再与 vᵀSv 合并，恰好恢复原二次型。Since A is positive definite, all its eigenvalues are positive, its nullspace is zero, and A⁻¹ exists. The square completion is legitimate: its first term expands to uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀBᵀA⁻¹Bv, whose last term combines with vᵀSv to recover the original quadratic form.

剩下的矩阵 S 称为关于块 A 的 。若 S 半正定，右边对所有 u、v 非负，所以 M 半正定。反向若 M 半正定，对任意 v 特意取 u=−A⁻¹Bv，便得到 vᵀSv≥0，故 S 也半正定。于是The remainder S is the of A. If S is PSD, the right side is nonnegative for every u,v, so M is PSD. Conversely, if M is PSD, set u=−A⁻¹Bv for arbitrary v to obtain vᵀSv≥0, hence S is PSD. Therefore

用途：把含逆矩阵的约束改写Application: rewriting an inverse constraint

例如 Y 为正定矩阵，x 为列向量，t 为实数。把 A=Y、B=x、C=t 代入，得到For positive definite Y, column x and scalar t, set A=Y, B=x, C=t:

右侧矩阵的各块直接由变量组成，不再显式求逆；以后会把这类仿射矩阵半正定约束称为线性矩阵不等式。这个改写必须同时保留 Y≻0，不能悄悄扩大到奇异矩阵。The block entries depend directly on the variables without an explicit inverse. Such affine PSD constraints will later be called linear matrix inequalities. Retain Y≻0 with this equivalence; singular Y is not covered.

补充阅读 · 课件中的行列式公式与奇异块Further reading · Determinants and singular blocks

块消元还给出行列式公式。左乘下面的块三角矩阵，右上和左下的耦合便被消去一侧；消元矩阵行列式为 1，块三角矩阵的行列式为对角块行列式之积。因此 A 可逆时，Block elimination also gives a determinant formula. The left triangular elimination matrix below has determinant one. Its product with M is block triangular, whose determinant is the product of the diagonal-block determinants. Thus for invertible A,

这个行列式公式只要求 A 可逆；前面的半正定等价还要求 A 正定。A 仅半正定时，完整的半正定判据为下面三条同时成立，其中 A† 是上一节的伪逆。第二条保证 B 的列都在 A 的值域中。The determinant identity requires only invertible A; the earlier PSD equivalence requires positive definite A. For a merely PSD A, all three conditions below are needed. A† is the pseudoinverse, and the second condition says that columns of B lie in the range of A.

值域条件为何必要？如果 w∈N(A)，却有 wᵀBv≠0，那么取 u=tw 时二次型含 2t wᵀBv，选择 t 的符号并放大就会得到负值。满足值域条件后，可用 A† 代替 A⁻¹ 配方，证明与正文相同。例如 A=diag(1,0)、B=(0,1)ᵀ、C=2，形式上的补为 2，却因值域条件失败而非半正定。Why is range compatibility necessary? If w∈N(A) has wᵀBv≠0, choosing u=tw leaves the term 2t wᵀBv, made negative by a sufficiently large signed t. Under range compatibility, complete the square with A† in place of A⁻¹. For A=diag(1,0), B=(0,1)ᵀ, C=2, the formal complement is two but the range condition fails, so M is not PSD.

这里 v 固定，而 u=tw 满足 uᵀAu=t²wᵀAw=0。剩下 2t wᵀBv+vᵀCv 中第二项是常数，第一项可随 t 趋于负无穷，所以必然产生负二次型。Here v is fixed and u=tw gives uᵀAu=t²wᵀAw=0. In 2t wᵀBv+vᵀCv the second term is constant, while the first can tend to minus infinity with t. The quadratic form must then become negative.

在这个反例中 A†B=(0,0)ᵀ，故 (I−AA†)B=(0,1)ᵀ≠0，正好检查出缺失的值域条件。In this counterexample A†B=(0,0)ᵀ, so (I−AA†)B=(0,1)ᵀ≠0, explicitly detecting the failed range condition.

更完整地说，A 半正定时 A⁻¹ 可能不存在。由特征分解可知 AA† 是到 R(A) 的正交投影，且 A†AA†=A†。若 (I−AA†)B=0，就有 AA†B=B，因而用 A† 配方确实恢复原交叉项：More explicitly, a PSD A may be singular. Eigen-decomposition shows that AA† is the orthogonal projection onto R(A), and A†AA†=A†. If (I−AA†)B=0, then AA†B=B. Completing the square with A† therefore reproduces the original cross term:

前两项条件满足后，剩余补半正定使右边处处非负；反向取 u=−A†Bv 即读出补的半正定性。若 M 半正定，取 v=0 得 A 半正定，前面的 w 测试又强迫值域条件，至此三个条件的必要与充分性都得到说明。Under the first two conditions, a PSD remainder makes the right side nonnegative. Conversely set u=−A†Bv to test that remainder. If M is PSD, taking v=0 gives A PSD, and the earlier w-test forces range compatibility. This establishes necessity and sufficiency of all three conditions.

3.4 多面体、单纯形与半正定锥3.4 Polyhedra, simplexes and the PSD cone

多个线性约束同时成立时，可行集是多个半空间和超平面的交，称为。有限个约束即可定义它，形状不必有界。例如第一象限由 x₁≥0、x₂≥0 定义，向外无限延伸。Simultaneous linear constraints give the intersection of finitely many halfspaces and hyperplanes, a . It need not be bounded: the quadrant x₁≥0,x₂≥0 extends indefinitely.

是另一种常见形状：把仿射独立的点取凸包。仿射独立指以其中一点为起点的差向量线性独立。二维三个不共线点形成三角形。标准单纯形则直接把凸组合的权重作为坐标：A is the convex hull of affinely independent points: their differences from one chosen point are linearly independent. Three noncollinear planar points form a triangle. The standard simplex uses mixture weights themselves as coordinates:

k=3 时只有两个自由参数，因为 θ₃=1−θ₁−θ₂。图的横纵轴是 θ₁、θ₂；它画的是三维平面中三角形的二维参数图。在 R³ 中这个集合没有普通内点，但在自身平面中有相对内部。For k=3 there are only two free parameters since θ₃=1−θ₁−θ₂. The plot uses θ₁,θ₂ and parametrizes a triangle in a three-dimensional plane. It has empty ordinary interior in R³ but nonempty relative interior within its plane.

矩阵也可以组成凸集Matrices can form convex sets

所有 n×n 实对称半正定矩阵组成半正定锥 Sⁿ₊。若 X、Y 半正定，对任意 v，vᵀ[(1−θ)X+θY]v 是两个非负数的非负加权和，所以混合矩阵半正定。非负缩放同样保持非负，因此它也是凸锥。The real symmetric PSD n×n matrices form the PSD cone Sⁿ₊. For PSD X,Y and any v, the quadratic form of (1−θ)X+θY is a nonnegative weighted sum of nonnegative numbers. Scaling by a nonnegative scalar also preserves the property, so this is a convex cone.

Every three-dimensional ball contains points whose coordinates do not sum to one, so it is not interior in R³.

3.5 保持凸性的集合运算3.5 Set operations preserving convexity

遇到复杂可行集，不必每次从头证明。先把它拆成已知凸集及保持凸性的运算。最简单的是交集：如果 x、y 同时满足每一组凸约束，它们的线段也同时满足每组约束。因此任意多个凸集的交仍凸，交集为空也不例外。For complicated feasible sets, decompose them into known convex sets and convexity-preserving operations. Intersections are simplest: if x,y satisfy every convex constraint, their segment does too. Any intersection of convex sets is convex, including an empty intersection result.

并集一般不保持凸性。例如两个分离的圆盘分别凸，跨圆盘取两点，中间线段却可能穿过空白。Unions generally fail to preserve convexity. Two separated disks are individually convex, but a segment joining them can cross the gap.

仿射像与原像Affine images and preimages

设 f(x)=Ax+b。凸集 C 的像是所有 f(x)，x∈C。两个像点混合后等于原空间中两点混合再映射，因为 f((1−θ)x+θy)=(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)，所以像仍凸。这个证明允许 A 是矩形或不可逆矩阵。For f(x)=Ax+b, the image of convex C contains all f(x) with x∈C. Mixing two image points equals mapping the mixture, so the image is convex. A may be rectangular or noninvertible.

则反过来问：哪些输入的输出落在给定凸集 D？记号 f⁻¹(D) 在这里表示集合原像，不要求逆函数存在。若 x、y 的输出都在 D，混合输出仍在 D，所以原像也凸。The asks which inputs produce outputs in a convex target D. The notation f⁻¹(D) does not require an inverse function. Feasible outputs remain in D under mixing, so the preimage is convex too.

例如 {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} 是欧氏球在仿射映射下的原像，故凸。两个凸集的和 C+D={x+y:x∈C,y∈D} 也凸：对两组和作混合时，分别混合 C 中和 D 中的两点即可。For example, {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} is an affine preimage of a Euclidean ball, hence convex. The sum C+D={x+y:x∈C,y∈D} is convex too: mix the C components and D components separately.

3.6 透视与线性分式映射3.6 Perspective and linear-fractional maps

仿射映射保持混合比例。则把点 (z,t) 沿过原点的射线投到高度 1，得到 z/t。这里必须要求 t>0；分母符号决定后面的混合权重是否仍非负。Affine maps preserve mixture weights. A sends (z,t) along its ray from zero to height one, producing z/t. Require t>0: its sign determines whether transformed mixture weights stay nonnegative.

例如 (0,1)、(2,2) 分别映到 0、1。输入中点 (1,1.5) 却映到 2/3，而非输出中点 1/2。因此透视不是仿射，但它仍会把凸集变成凸集，原因是混合权重发生了可控制的改变。For (0,1) and (2,2), the images are zero and one. Their midpoint (1,1.5) maps to 2/3 rather than one half. Perspective is not affine, but preserves convexity because the change of weights is controlled.

从像中任取两点 q₁、q₂，分别选择产生它们的输入 (z₁,t₁)、(z₂,t₂)，其中 t₁,t₂>0。这两个高度固定下来后，再混合输入。下式分子是混合后的水平坐标，分母是混合后的高度：Take any two image points q₁,q₂ and choose preimages (z₁,t₁),(z₂,t₂), with positive heights. Fix these heights and mix the inputs. The numerator below is the mixed horizontal coordinate; the denominator is the mixed height:

t₁、t₂ 正，故分母正且 λ∈[0,1]。为了证明像凸，还要确认任意输出权重 λ 都能得到。给定 λ，取 θ=λt₁/((1−λ)t₂+λt₁)，它也在 [0,1]，代入即还原 λ。因此输出整段线段都可由凸的输入集产生。Positive t₁,t₂ make λ∈[0,1]. To prove the image convex, also obtain every desired λ: choose θ=λt₁/((1−λ)t₂+λt₁). This lies in [0,1] and recovers λ, so the entire output segment arises from the convex input set.

反解中的分母 (1−λ)t₂+λt₁>0，且减去分子 λt₁ 后为 (1−λ)t₂≥0，故 0≤θ≤1。输入集凸，保证这个反解权重对应的混合输入可行，于是任意指定的输出线段点也可行。The inverse denominator (1−λ)t₂+λt₁ is positive and exceeds its numerator λt₁ by (1−λ)t₂≥0, so 0≤θ≤1. Input convexity makes this mixture feasible and produces every desired point on the output segment.

线性分式映射先做仿射映射，再作透视：f(x)=(Ax+b)/(cᵀx+d)，定义域限制 cᵀx+d>0。它保持凸集的像；凸目标集的原像也凸，可由刚才的正权重关系直接核对。正分母条件始终要与映射一起保留。A linear-fractional map is an affine map followed by perspective: f(x)=(Ax+b)/(cᵀx+d), on cᵀx+d>0. It preserves convexity of images and preimages of convex target sets, using the same positive-weight identity. Always retain the positive-denominator domain.

练习Exercise

上面两个输入点要得到输出中点 1/2，输入应如何混合？How should the two example inputs be mixed to obtain output one half?

提示Hint

令 t₁=1、t₂=2、λ=1/2，代入 θ 的反解。Use t₁=1, t₂=2 and λ=1/2 in the inverse weight formula.

解答与核对Solution and check

θ=1/3，输入为 (2/3,4/3)，透视后为 1/2。输入不取中点，正说明混合参数发生了改变。θ=1/3 gives input (2/3,4/3), whose perspective is one half. The input is not the midpoint, demonstrating the change of mixture parameter.

核对原课件 · 第3讲 36-40页Original slides · Lecture 3, pp. 36-40

3.8 最小、极小与弱极小3.8 Minimum, minimal and weakly minimal points

在向量偏序下，一个点可能与许多点不可比较。设两个坐标分别表示费用和误差，都越小越好。方案 (1,4) 费用低，(4,1) 误差低，谁也没有在两个指标上同时胜过对方。因此需要区分“比所有点都小”和“没有点能支配它”。In a partial order, many vectors are incomparable. If coordinates represent cost and error, both to be minimized, (1,4) is cheaper while (4,1) is more accurate. Neither improves both coordinates. Distinguish being below every point from having no dominating competitor.

x∈S 是最小元素，要求 x⪯Ky 对所有 y∈S 成立。x 是极小元素，则只要求不存在不同的 y∈S 满足 y⪯Kx。最小元素若存在，由至多一个；极小元素可以很多，也可以没有。A minimum x∈S satisfies x⪯Ky for every y∈S. A minimal x has no distinct y∈S with y⪯Kx. Pointedness makes a minimum unique if it exists; minimal points can be numerous or absent.

例如 S={(0,1),(1,0)} 中两点都极小，但没有。若加入 (0,0)，它就成为最小元素，也支配原来的两点。图中连线只是帮助看位置，不能据此认定连线上的中间方案可行。In S={(0,1),(1,0)}, both points are minimal but no minimum exists. Adding (0,0) makes it a minimum, dominating the original points. Connecting lines in a plot do not assert feasibility of intermediate plans.

弱极小只排除严格改善的点：不存在 y∈S 使 y≺Kx。对非负正交象限，这要求所有坐标都严格更小。它比极小弱；例如 S={(1,1),(1,2)} 中 (1,2) 被 (1,1) 支配，故不极小，但没有点让两个坐标都严格下降，所以它仍弱极小。Weak minimality excludes y≺Kx, strict improvement in every coordinate for the orthant. This is weaker: in S={(1,1),(1,2)}, point (1,2) is dominated by (1,1) and is not minimal, but is weakly minimal since neither point decreases both coordinates strictly.

这里 y≺Kx 沿用 3.7 的定义，表示 x−y∈int K；正交象限的内部是所有坐标都严格正。因此“不存在严格改善”只排除所有坐标同时严格下降，不排除一项相等、另一项变小的支配。Here y≺Kx means x−y∈int K as in Section 3.7. The orthant interior has every coordinate strictly positive. Weak minimality therefore excludes improvements strict in every coordinate, but permits domination with a tied coordinate.

练习Exercise

S={(1,3),(2,2),(3,3)} 中哪些点极小？是否有最小元素？Which points are minimal in S={(1,3),(2,2),(3,3)}? Is there a minimum?

提示Hint

逐点寻找是否有另一个点两坐标均不大于它，且至少一项更小。For each point, seek another no larger in either coordinate and smaller in at least one.

解答与核对Solution and check

(1,3)、(2,2) 极小且不可比较。(3,3) 被它们支配，不极小。没有一个点不大于所有其他点，所以没有最小元素。Points (1,3) and (2,2) are minimal and incomparable. Both dominate (3,3), which is not minimal. No point lies below all others, so no minimum exists.

核对原课件 · 第3讲 47-48页Original slides · Lecture 3, pp. 47-48

3.9 分离：用一个线性评分区分集合3.9 Separation by a linear score

凸集虽可能由复杂约束定义，却常能用线性评分描述它与外部点的区别。最简单的图像是两个不相交圆盘：找一条直线，让它们分居两侧。高维中直线换成超平面。A convex set may have complicated constraints yet admit a linear score distinguishing it from another set or an outside point. Picture two disjoint disks on opposite sides of a line. In higher dimensions the line becomes a hyperplane.

这叫弱分离，允许点落在超平面上；严格分离则要求存在正间隙，例如 supₓ∈C aᵀx < infᵧ∈D aᵀy。两种说法的假设不同，不能只凭两个集合不相交就断言有正间隙。This is weak separation, allowing points on the hyperplane. Strict separation requires a gap, for example sup over C of aᵀx less than inf over D of aᵀy. Disjointness alone does not guarantee that gap.

本章使用有限维分离定理：两个非空、不相交的凸集可以弱分离。若其中一个紧致、另一个闭，则可以严格分离。例如点 z 位于非空闭凸集 C 外面时，点集 {z} 紧致，因此严格分离成立。一般非闭情形如 C=(−∞,0)、D={0}，只能在边界零处接触，无法留出正间隙。We use the finite-dimensional separation theorem: two nonempty disjoint convex sets can be weakly separated. If one is compact and the other closed, strict separation is possible. Thus an outside point can be strictly separated from a nonempty closed convex set. Nonclosed examples such as C=(−∞,0), D={0} need not have a positive gap.

外部点的分离方向从哪里来？Where does the separating direction come from?

对非空闭凸 C，取离 z 最近的点 p，令 a=z−p≠0。最近点存在：可将搜索限制到一个足够大的闭球内，再用连续函数在紧集取极小值。对任意 x∈C，线段 p+θ(x−p) 留在 C，故距离平方在 θ=0 处不能向右下降。求右导数得For nonempty closed convex C, choose a nearest point p to z and a=z−p≠0. A nearest point exists by restricting the search to a sufficiently large closed ball and minimizing continuous distance on the resulting compact set. For x∈C, p+θ(x−p) stays feasible, so squared distance cannot decrease to the right at θ=0. Its right derivative gives

所以最近点提供了明确的法向和正间隙。C 的凸性在这里保证线段可行，闭性负责最近点存在；两者各有作用。The nearest point supplies both a normal and a positive gap. Convexity keeps the segment feasible; closedness supports nearest-point existence.

练习Exercise

C={x∈R²:x₁≤0}，z=(2,1)。求最近点 p 和一个分离法向。For C={x∈R²:x₁≤0}, z=(2,1), find a nearest p and separating normal.

提示Hint

保持第二坐标不变，只需把第一坐标移到允许边界。Keep the second coordinate and move the first to the allowed boundary.

解答与核对Solution and check

p=(0,1)，a=(2,0)。所有 x∈C 有 aᵀx≤0，而 aᵀz=4。取评分阈值 2，可把两者严格分开。p=(0,1), a=(2,0). All x∈C satisfy aᵀx≤0, while aᵀz=4. Score threshold two strictly separates them.

3.10 支撑超平面：在边界托住集合3.10 Supporting hyperplanes at a boundary

分离把两个集合分居两侧。若一个超平面通过 C 的边界点 x₀，同时把整个 C 留在同一侧，就称为 C 在 x₀ 的。法向必须非零：A passes through a boundary point x₀ and leaves the whole set C on one side. Its normal must be nonzero:

例如单位圆盘在 x₀=(1,0) 处由 x₁=1 支撑，法向为 (1,0)。这与第二章对偶范数图中的“最后接触”相同：固定方向 a，使线性评分在单位球上达到最大值。The unit disk is supported at x₀=(1,0) by x₁=1, with normal (1,0). This is the last contact in the dual-norm diagram: maximize the linear score in direction a over the ball.

支撑超平面定理说：非空凸集的每个边界点都存在支撑超平面；边界点即使不属于集合，也可对其闭包理解这个支撑。若想用“在某个可行边界点接触”的说法，就明确取 x₀∈C∩∂C。非凸集合则不保证每个边界点都有全局支撑。The supporting-hyperplane theorem gives a supporting hyperplane at every boundary point of a nonempty convex set. If a boundary point is excluded, understand support through its closure. For actual feasible contact take x₀∈C∩∂C. Nonconvex sets need not have global support at every boundary point.

椭球 C={x:xᵀPx≤1}、P≻0，在边界点 x₀ 的一个法向是 Px₀。它非零，因为边界上 x₀≠0 且 P 可逆。换到 P½ 坐标，柯西–施瓦茨给出For ellipsoid C={x:xᵀPx≤1} with P≻0, a normal at boundary x₀ is Px₀, nonzero since x₀≠0 and P is invertible. Cauchy–Schwarz in transformed coordinates gives

由第二章矩阵平方根恒等式 P½P½=P，上面的内积可这样改写。x₀ 在边界上，故 ‖P½x₀‖₂²=x₀ᵀPx₀=1；x 在椭球内，故 ‖P½x‖₂≤1。把两条长度界代入柯西–施瓦茨，便得到The square-root identity P½P½=P justifies the rewrite. Boundary membership gives ‖P½x₀‖₂²=x₀ᵀPx₀=1, while x in the ellipsoid has ‖P½x‖₂≤1. Substitute these lengths in Cauchy–Schwarz:

这验证了整个椭球都在同侧，不能只检查法向是否垂直于局部切线。支撑是一个全局不等式。This checks the entire ellipsoid lies on one side. Perpendicularity to a local tangent alone is not enough: support is a global inequality.

练习Exercise

椭圆 4x₁²+x₂²≤1 在 x₀=(1/2,0) 的支撑直线是什么？Find a supporting line of 4x₁²+x₂²≤1 at x₀=(1/2,0).

提示Hint

法向取 Px₀，P=diag(4,1)。Use normal Px₀ for P=diag(4,1).

解答与核对Solution and check

Px₀=(2,0)，所以支撑直线 2x₁=1，即 x₁=1/2；整个椭圆满足 x₁≤1/2。Px₀=(2,0), giving 2x₁=1, or x₁=1/2. The full ellipse satisfies x₁≤1/2.

4.4 次水平集与上图：把函数变成集合4.4 Sublevel sets and epigraphs

有时我们只关心费用能否低于门槛 α。这些输入组成 Cα={x:f(x)≤α}。若 f 凸，两个费用不超过 α 的点混合后，费用也不超过 α，所以每个次水平集都凸。If we only ask whether a cost is at most threshold α, the acceptable inputs form the Cα={x:f(x)≤α}. A convex f has convex sublevel sets: mixing two costs at most α keeps the cost at most α.

但这只描述哪些点达标，没有描述两端费用应怎样加权。逆命题不成立：x³ 的次水平集总是形如 (−∞,c]，都凸，而 x³ 在 R 上不凸。第五章称这种较弱性质为拟凸。Sublevel sets identify acceptable points without controlling weighted endpoint costs. The converse fails: every sublevel set of x³ is a half-line and is convex, but x³ is not convex on R. Chapter 5 calls the weaker property quasiconvexity.

若同时把费用上限 t 作为额外坐标，就得到：所有位于函数图像上或上方的点。它包含上方区域，而不只是一条曲线。Add the cost allowance t as another coordinate to obtain the : all points on or above the graph, not just the graph itself.

f 凸当且仅当 epi f 凸。正向：混合两组 f(x)≤t，用函数凸性就有 f(混合x)≤混合t。反向：取两个恰在图像上的点 (x,f(x))、(y,f(y))，上图集凸便强迫混合点在图像上方，这正是函数凸性定义。The function is convex exactly when its epigraph is convex. Forward: mix two feasible pairs f(x)≤t and use function convexity. Reverse: mix graph points (x,f(x)) and (y,f(y)); epigraph convexity gives exactly the defining function inequality.

练习Exercise

写出 |x| 的上图集，并用线性不等式表示。Write the epigraph of |x| using linear inequalities.

提示Hint

|x|≤t 同时控制 x 与 −x。The inequality |x|≤t bounds both x and −x.

解答与核对Solution and check

它是两个半空间的交，因而凸，也再次证明 |x| 凸。It is the intersection of two halfspaces, hence convex, proving convexity of |x| again.

核对原课件 · 第4讲 25-27页Original slides · Lecture 4, pp. 25-27

4.5 矩阵分式函数：用上图证明凸性4.5 Matrix fractional functions via epigraphs

考虑 f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x，Y 为实对称正定矩阵。x 是一个向量，Y 也允许变化，所以要证明的是它们的联合凸性。仅仅固定 Y 看 x 的二次型，还没有完成任务。Consider f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x for symmetric positive definite Y. Both x and Y vary, so the task is joint convexity; fixing Y and checking a quadratic in x is insufficient.

直接对向量和矩阵同时求二阶导比较繁琐。第二章的 Schur 补可以把上图条件改成半正定矩阵：Differentiating jointly in a vector and matrix is cumbersome. The Schur complement converts the epigraph condition into a PSD matrix:

具体应用 2.13：把正定块取为 Y，Schur 补就是 t−xᵀY⁻¹x。它非负恰好表示 f(x,Y)≤t，因此下面确实是同一个上图集。Apply Section 2.13 with positive definite block Y. Its Schur complement is t−xᵀY⁻¹x, nonnegative exactly when f(x,Y)≤t. The set below is therefore precisely the epigraph.

Y≻0 是凸条件：两个正定矩阵非平凡混合后，对非零 v 的二次型仍正。分块矩阵又是变量的仿射函数，半正定锥凸，因此其原像凸。两条件相交仍凸，上图集判据就证明了 f 的联合凸性。整个过程中 Y≻0 都要保留。Positive definiteness is convex: nonzero-direction quadratic forms remain positive under mixing. The block matrix is affine in its variables and the PSD cone is convex, so its preimage is convex. Their intersection is convex, proving joint convexity by the epigraph test. Retain Y≻0 throughout.

练习Exercise

当 Y 只有一个正数 y 时，这个函数和上图条件变成什么？What are the function and epigraph condition when Y is a positive scalar y?

提示Hint

把矩阵块按标量展开，求关于 y 的 Schur 补。Use scalar blocks and eliminate y.

解答与核对Solution and check

这说明 x²/y 对 (x,y) 联合凸，定义域是 y>0。Thus x²/y is jointly convex in (x,y), on y>0.

核对原课件 · 第4讲 28-32页Original slides · Lecture 4, pp. 28-32

4.7 非负加权和与仿射复合4.7 Nonnegative sums and affine composition

实际目标常由多个费用组成，例如拟合误差加惩罚项。若每项凸，且权重非负，把各项凸性不等式乘权重再相加，就证明总费用凸。负权重会反转不等号，不能直接使用这条规则。Practical objectives combine costs, such as a fit error and a penalty. Convex terms with nonnegative weights yield a convex sum: multiply each defining inequality by its weight and add. Negative weights reverse inequalities and invalidate this rule.

先确认共同定义域凸。若用扩展值 +∞ 表示约束，对零权重项直接删去，避免把 0·∞ 当作普通运算。例如 ‖Ax−b‖₂²+λ‖x‖₁ 在 λ≥0 时凸，因为两项凸、共同定义域为 Rⁿ。Check that the common domain is convex. With extended values, remove zero-weight terms rather than treating 0·∞ as ordinary arithmetic. For example, ‖Ax−b‖₂²+λ‖x‖₁ is convex for λ≥0 on Rⁿ.

仿射复合也保持凸性：g(x)=f(Ax+b)。两个输入混合后，Ax+b 正好等于两个输出的同权混合，所以可直接用 f 的凸性。其定义域是 f 定义域的仿射原像，也凸。Affine composition preserves convexity: g(x)=f(Ax+b). The affine output of a mixture is the same mixture of outputs, so apply convexity of f. The domain is an affine preimage of a convex domain and remains convex.

练习Exercise

λ>0 时，函数 (x−1)²−λ|x| 能否仅凭加权和规则断言凸？For λ>0, can convexity of (x−1)²−λ|x| be concluded from the sum rule?

提示Hint

|x| 前的权重是负的；还可检查零点两侧导数。The weight on |x| is negative; inspect derivatives at zero as well.

解答与核对Solution and check

不能。零点左导数为 −2+λ，右导数为 −2−λ，斜率向下跳，违背一元凸函数斜率不减。这也给出实际的非凸证据。No. The left derivative is −2+λ and the right derivative −2−λ, a downward jump violating nondecreasing slopes of a convex function.

核对原课件 · 第4讲 36-38页Original slides · Lecture 4, pp. 36-38

4.8 最大值、上确界与支撑函数4.8 Maxima, suprema and support functions

如果目标控制最坏费用，就会出现 f(x)=maxᵢfᵢ(x)。所有 fᵢ 凸时，它也凸：先对任意一项使用凸性，再把两端分别用最大值压住，最后对该项取最大值。Worst-case costs lead to f(x)=maxᵢfᵢ(x). If every fᵢ is convex, so is f: bound any term at a mixture by its weighted endpoint values, bound each endpoint by its maximum, then maximize the term.

例如 max(x,2−x) 在 x=1 处换主导项，出现尖角，但仍凸。可微性与凸性是两件事。把有限最大值换成非空函数族的逐点上确界，同样的共同上界证明仍成立；上确界允许 +∞，必须另外检查有效域。For max(x,2−x), the active term changes at one, creating a corner while preserving convexity. Differentiability is separate from convexity. The same proof works for the pointwise supremum of a nonempty family. The value can be +∞, so check the effective domain separately.

例：集合在某方向上能走多远？Example: how far can a set extend in a direction?

非空集合 C 的 hC(y)=supₓ∈C yᵀx。每个固定 x 给一个关于 y 的线性函数，故无论 C 本身凸不凸，支撑函数都凸。若 C 是某范数单位球，它就是第二章的对偶范数。For nonempty C, its is hC(y)=sup over x∈C of yᵀx. Each fixed x gives a linear function of y, so the support function is convex even if C is not. For a norm unit ball it is the dual norm from Chapter 2.

实对称矩阵的最大特征值也有同样结构：由正交特征分解，单位 v 的 vᵀXv 不超过最大特征值，取最大特征方向达到。因此 λmax 是一族关于 X 的线性函数的最大值，所以凸。The largest eigenvalue of a symmetric matrix has this structure. Eigen-decomposition bounds vᵀXv for unit v by the largest eigenvalue, attained in its eigen-direction. Thus λmax is a maximum of functions linear in X and is convex.

补充阅读 · 凸函数由仿射下界表示Further reading · Representation by affine lower bounds

对闭的正常凸函数，即不恒为 +∞、从不取 −∞ 且下半连续的凸函数，可以用所有仿射下界的逐点上确界恢复它。下半连续指函数值不高于趋近序列的极限下界；等价地，上图集闭。这是分离定理的函数版本，完整证明见教材3.2.3及共轭讨论。第四章先用已经证明的一阶下界理解其几何，第五章会系统引入共轭。A closed proper convex function can be recovered as the supremum of all affine lower bounds. Proper means never −∞ and not identically +∞; closed means lower semicontinuous, equivalently a closed epigraph. Lower semicontinuity bounds the value by the liminf along approaching sequences. This is a functional separation theorem; Chapter 5 develops its conjugate interpretation.

y>0 取 x=2，y<0 取 x=−1；y=0 时所有点取等。函数等于 max(2y,−y)，所以凸。Use x=2 for y>0 and x=−1 for y<0; every x attains zero at y=0. The function is max(2y,−y), hence convex.

4.9 一般复合：单调性负责哪一步4.9 Composition: the role of monotonicity

仿射内层可以直接保持混合，但一般凸内层只给一个不等式。若外函数 h 凸且不减，内函数 g 凸，并在已知凸域 D 上所有 g(x) 都属于 h 的定义域，就能依次使用单调性与凸性：An affine inner map preserves mixtures exactly; a convex inner function gives only an inequality. If h is convex and nondecreasing, g is convex, and g(x) is in the domain of h for every x in a convex D, use monotonicity and convexity in sequence:

第一步来自 g 凸，再由 h 不减保持方向；第二步才使用 h 凸。例如 exp(‖x‖₂) 凸，因为指数函数凸且递增，范数凸。如果 h 凸且不增，则内层应凹，使第一步方向再次正确；例子 −log g 在 g 为正凹函数的凸域上凸。The first step combines convex g with nondecreasing h; the second uses convex h. For example exp(‖x‖₂) is convex. If h is convex and nonincreasing, use a concave inner g instead; for instance −log g is convex on a convex domain where g is positive and concave.

定义域检查不能省。比如 h(u)=u² 限于 u≥0 时不减，g(x)=x²−1 凸，但自然复合域 {x:x²−1≥0} 不凸，所以不能宣称该自然域上的复合为凸函数。可以限制到 [1,∞) 等已知凸域再应用规则。教材的扩展值单调规则会把这类域限制一并编码。Domain checks are essential. The function h(u)=u² on u≥0 is nondecreasing and g(x)=x²−1 is convex, but their natural composition domain {x:x²−1≥0} is nonconvex. Restrict to a known convex domain such as [1,∞) before applying the rule. Extended-value monotonicity rules encode these domain restrictions.

向量内层也类似：外函数联合凸，且在各分量上不减，各内层 gᵢ 凸时，可以先逐分量比较，再应用外函数。若某个外分量不增，对应内层需凹；外层整体还必须是联合凸函数。For vector inner maps, a jointly convex outer function nondecreasing in each coordinate can be composed with convex components gᵢ. Compare components first, then apply the outer function. A nonincreasing outer coordinate instead needs a concave inner component.

练习Exercise

为什么不能用“凸函数套凸函数”证明 −log(x²) 在其自然定义域凸？Why cannot “convex composed with convex” prove convexity of −log(x²) on its natural domain?

提示Hint

解答与核对Solution and check

−log 在正半轴递减，不能套凸内层的递增规则；自然域 R\{0} 又不凸。在正半轴上该式等于 −2log x，确实凸，但这是额外计算得到，说明复合充分规则不适用时也不能直接断言函数非凸。The outer −log is decreasing, so the increasing-outer rule fails, and R\{0} is nonconvex. On the positive half-line the function is −2log x and is convex by direct calculation. Failure of a sufficient composition rule does not prove nonconvexity.

4.10 部分最小化与函数透视4.10 Partial minimization and perspectives

模型中有些变量只用于辅助计算。我们希望先对这些变量优化，留下原变量的费用。设 f(x,y) 在联合凸域上联合凸，定义 g(x)=infᵧf(x,y)。这里使用 inf，因为最优 y 可能不存在。先假设 g 不取 −∞；没有允许 y 时取 +∞。Some model variables are auxiliary. Minimize over them to obtain a reduced cost g(x)=infᵧf(x,y) for jointly convex f on a jointly convex domain. Use inf because a minimizing y may not exist. Assume g never takes −∞, and assign +∞ when no y is feasible.

证明 g 凸不能随意写“取最优 y”。对 g(x₁)、g(x₂) 有限的情形，给定 ε>0，分别选近似解 y₁、y₂，使 f(xᵢ,yᵢ)≤g(xᵢ)+ε。联合凸性给出Do not assume optimal y values exist. If g(x₁),g(x₂) are finite, choose ε-approximate y₁,y₂ with f(xᵢ,yᵢ)≤g(xᵢ)+ε. Joint convexity yields

ε 任意小，令它趋零就得凸性。联合定义域的凸性确保混合后的辅助变量仍可行。只分别对 x、y 凸不够：f(x,y)=xy 对每个变量分别仿射，却不联合凸，例如 (1,−1)、(−1,1) 的中点费用 0，高于端点平均 −1。Let ε decrease to zero. Convexity of the joint domain keeps the mixed auxiliary variable feasible. Separate convexity is insufficient: xy is affine separately, but the midpoint of (1,−1) and (−1,1) has value zero, above average endpoint value −1.

例如到非空凸集 C 的距离 d(x)=infᵧ∈C‖x−y‖₂ 是凸的，因为范数关于 (x,y) 联合凸、域 Rⁿ×C 凸。C 不闭时最近点可能不存在，但 inf 与上面的证明仍适用。Distance to a nonempty convex C, d(x)=inf over y∈C of ‖x−y‖₂, is convex: the norm is jointly convex in (x,y), and Rⁿ×C is convex. If C is not closed, nearest points may fail to exist, but the infimum proof remains valid.

透视：同时改变输入与尺度Perspective: changing input and scale together

对凸函数 f 定义 g(x,t)=t f(x/t)，t>0 且 x/t∈dom f。它先按尺度 t 归一化输入，再把费用乘回尺度。两个输入尺度不同，混合后的归一化点也要换权重。设 t=(1−θ)t₁+θt₂>0，λ=θt₂/t，则For convex f define g(x,t)=t f(x/t), with t>0 and x/t∈dom f. Normalize the input by t, evaluate its cost and scale back. Different scales change the normalized mixture weights. Set t=(1−θ)t₁+θt₂>0 and λ=θt₂/t:

这个权重由归一化直接决定：x₁/t₁ 前的系数必须是 (1−θ)t₁/t，x₂/t₂ 前的系数必须是 θt₂/t。两者非负且和为 1，所以 λ∈[0,1]，下一步能合法使用 f 的凸性。Normalization determines the weights: the coefficients of x₁/t₁ and x₂/t₂ must be (1−θ)t₁/t and θt₂/t. They are nonnegative and sum to one, so λ∈[0,1] and convexity of f applies.

对右边用 f 的凸性，乘回 t，两个系数恰变为 (1−θ)t₁、θt₂，证明 g 联合凸，定义域也因同样的凸组合而凸。f(x)=x² 时得到 x²/t，正是前面 Schur 补的例子。Apply convexity of f and multiply by t. The weights become (1−θ)t₁ and θt₂, proving joint convexity; the same mixture verifies the domain is convex. With f(x)=x² we obtain x²/t, matching the Schur-complement example.

核对原课件 · 第4讲 56-63页Original slides · Lecture 4, pp. 56-63

5.1 共轭：固定斜率，寻找最紧下界5.1 Conjugates: the best lower bound at a fixed slope

给定函数 f，想用直线 yx+b 从下方托住它。固定斜率 y，要求这条直线在每个允许输入 x 处都不超过 f(x)。这相当于对每个 x 都有 b≤f(x)−yx。因此能选的最大截距是这些右边的下确界。To support a function f from below with a line yx+b, fix slope y and require yx+b≤f(x) at every allowed x. Thus b≤f(x)−yx for every x, and the largest allowed intercept is the infimum of these right sides.

习惯上把这个截距的负数定义为共轭值。向量情形把乘法换成内积：Convention defines the conjugate value as the negative of that best intercept. For vectors use an inner product:

这里 y 固定，x 才是被优化的变量，上确界只在 x∈dom f 上取。原函数定义域 dom f 收集允许的 x；共轭定义域 dom f* 则收集使这个上确界有限的 y。有些斜率使目标无界，此时共轭值为 +∞，不存在有限截距的全局下界。若 f 从不取 −∞ 且至少一点有限，称它正常；此时 f* 不会取 −∞。Here y is fixed and x is optimized only over dom f. The original domain contains allowed x; the conjugate domain contains y for which that supremum is finite. Some slopes give +∞, with no finite-intercept global lower bound. A function never −∞ and finite somewhere is called proper; its conjugate never takes −∞.

正常性保证至少有一个 x₀ 使 f(x₀) 有限。对任意固定 y，共轭定义中的目标在 x₀ 处就是有限数 yᵀx₀−f(x₀)，上确界至少不小于这个数，所以不可能为 −∞。Properness supplies a point x₀ with finite f(x₀). For every fixed y, the conjugate objective at x₀ is the finite number yᵀx₀−f(x₀). Its supremum is at least that value and therefore cannot be −∞.

例如 f(x)=x²/2、y=2，配方得 2x−x²/2=2−(x−2)²/2，最大值为 2，取 x=2。因此最佳下界为 2x−2；截距 −2 是共轭值 2 的负数。For f(x)=x²/2 and y=2, complete the square: 2x−x²/2=2−(x−2)²/2. The maximum two is attained at x=2. The best lower bound is 2x−2: intercept minus two is the negative conjugate value.

对每个固定 x，yᵀx−f(x) 关于 y 是仿射函数。第四章的上确界规则因此保证 f* 总是凸，即使原函数 f 不凸。星号的定义与第二章对偶范数不同；两者的联系需要具体计算，不能仅凭记号相同来判断。For fixed x, yᵀx−f(x) is affine in y. The supremum rule makes f* convex even when f is not. This star operation differs from the dual norm; their relationship requires calculation, not just matching notation.

这里具体引用 4.8：仿射函数都是凸函数，非空仿射函数族的逐点上确界仍凸。共轭正是这样一族以 x 为索引的仿射函数的上确界。Specifically, Section 4.8 says affine functions are convex and a pointwise supremum of a nonempty affine family remains convex. The conjugate is exactly such a supremum, indexed by x.

5.2 共轭计算：先看域，再找上界5.2 Computing conjugates: domains before derivatives

计算共轭时，固定 y 后把 yᵀx−f(x) 当作 x 的优化问题。求导只会给候选点，还要检查候选是否在域内、是否全局最大，以及边界能否使上确界更大。下面用二次函数、指数和负对数把这套方法走完整。For each fixed y, optimize yᵀx−f(x) over x. Differentiation gives candidates, not a complete answer: check domain membership, global optimality and boundary behavior. Quadratic, exponential and negative-logarithm examples illustrate the full method.

正定二次函数：配方同时给界与取等Positive definite quadratics: bounds and attainment

设 f(x)=xᵀPx/2，P 为实对称正定矩阵。以下平方项非负，故第一项是所有 x 的上界；取 x=P⁻¹y 时平方项为零，所以这个界能达到。Let f(x)=xᵀPx/2 for symmetric positive definite P. The square below is nonnegative, bounding the expression for every x. Choosing x=P⁻¹y removes it and attains the bound.

指数：斜率的正、零、负必须分开Exponential: positive, zero and negative slopes

取 f(x)=eˣ，域是 R。目标 q(x)=yx−eˣ。当 y>0，q′=y−eˣ=0 给 x=log y；q″=−eˣ<0，故它是唯一全局最大点，代入得 y log y−y。For f(x)=eˣ on R, optimize q(x)=yx−eˣ. If y>0, q′=y−eˣ=0 gives x=log y. Since q″=−eˣ<0, this is the unique global maximum, with value y log y−y.

y=0 时目标 −eˣ 始终小于零，x→−∞ 时才趋于零，所以上确界是零但不取得。y<0 时，x→−∞ 使 yx→+∞ 且 eˣ→0，故上确界为 +∞。这两个情形都不能通过“解导数等于零”得到。If y=0, −eˣ is always negative and approaches zero only as x tends to minus infinity: supremum zero is unattained. For y<0, letting x tend to minus infinity gives yx tending to +∞ while eˣ tends to zero, so the supremum is +∞. Neither case is found by solving a stationary equation.

负对数：有效斜率必须为负Negative logarithm: the slope must be negative

f(x)=−log x，域 x>0，目标为 yx+log x。只有 y<0 时，导数 y+1/x=0 才给出域内点 x=−1/y。二阶导 −1/x²<0，保证它全局最大，值为 −1−log(−y)。y>0 时令 x→∞，yx 与 log x 都增大；y=0 时虽没有线性项，log x 仍趋于 +∞。因此共轭仅在 y<0 有限。For f(x)=−log x on x>0, the objective is yx+log x. Only y<0 gives stationary x=−1/y. The second derivative −1/x²<0 establishes a global maximum of −1−log(−y). For y>0 both terms grow as x tends to infinity; for y=0 the logarithm alone tends to +∞. The conjugate is therefore finite only for y<0.

约束与线性评分：示性函数和支撑函数Constraints and scores: indicator and support

非空集合 C 的示性函数 δC 在 C 内为零、外为 +∞，所以共轭只是在 C 内最大化内积，正是上一章的支撑函数 hC。For a nonempty set C, its convex indicator δC is zero on C and +∞ elsewhere. Its conjugate simply maximizes the inner product over C, giving the support function hC from the preceding chapter.

若 C 还是闭凸集，支撑函数的共轭反过来是 δC。对 x∈C，任意 y 有 yᵀx≤hC(y)，目标不超过零，y=0 达到零。对 x∉C，分离定理给 yᵀx>hC(y)，将 y 正向放大，差值趋于 +∞。因此If C is also closed and convex, the support conjugate is δC. For x∈C, yᵀx≤hC(y) bounds the objective by zero, attained at y=0. For x outside C, separation supplies yᵀx>hC(y); scaling y makes the positive difference unbounded. Thus

注意双共轭回到各自原对象，不能把 hC 的双共轭写成 δC。一般正常函数的双共轭不超过原函数；恢复原函数需要闭凸等条件。Each biconjugate returns to its own original object; hC** is not δC. Generally a proper function has f**≤f; recovery needs closed convex assumptions.

范数：为什么共轭只取零或无穷？Norms: why zero or infinity?

设 f(x)=N(x)。若 N*(y)≤1，由对偶范数界，yᵀx−N(x)≤0，取 x=0 得零。若 N*(y)>1，选 N(u)=1 且 yᵀu>1，再取 x=tu，t→∞，正差随 t 无界增长。因此范数的共轭是对偶单位球的示性函数。Let f(x)=N(x). If N*(y)≤1, the dual bound gives yᵀx−N(x)≤0, attained at x=0. If N*(y)>1, select N(u)=1 with yᵀu>1 and scale x=tu. The positive difference grows unboundedly. The conjugate is the indicator of the dual unit ball.

这里单独区分符号： 表示第二章的对偶范数， 表示当前的函数共轭。前面的比较使用的正是 2.5 已证的 。Use distinct notation here: is the dual norm from Chapter 2, while is the function conjugate. The comparison uses the bound proved in Section 2.5.

这行特意用文字区分共轭与对偶范数：左边是函数共轭运算，球约束中的 N* 才是对偶长度。阅读不同教材时，同一个星号可能承担这两种记号，必须先看定义。The annotation distinguishes conjugacy from the dual norm: the left is a function conjugate, while the ball condition uses dual length. A star can mean either operation in different texts, so check the definition.

补充阅读 · 其他典型函数的完整计算Further reading · More standard conjugate calculations

仿射 f(x)=aᵀx+b 在 Rⁿ 上，目标为 (y−a)ᵀx−b。y=a 时恒为 −b；否则取 x=t(y−a)，t→∞ 便无界。因此共轭在 y=a 为 −b，其他处 +∞。For affine f(x)=aᵀx+b on Rⁿ, the objective is (y−a)ᵀx−b. At y=a it is constantly −b; otherwise x=t(y−a) makes it unbounded. The conjugate is −b at a and +∞ elsewhere.

负熵项 f(x)=x log x，x>0。求导 y−log x−1=0 给 x=eʸ⁻¹，二阶导为 −1/x<0，代入得 f*(y)=eʸ⁻¹，对所有实 y 都有限且取得。For f(x)=x log x on x>0, derivative y−log x−1 gives x=eʸ⁻¹. The objective second derivative is −1/x<0 and substitution gives f*(y)=eʸ⁻¹, finite and attained for every real y.

倒数 f(x)=1/x，x>0。y<0 时 y+1/x²=0，取 x=1/√(−y)，得到 −2√(−y)；目标二阶导 −2/x³<0。y=0 时 −1/x 向零逼近但不取得；y>0 时 x→∞ 无界。For f(x)=1/x on x>0, y<0 gives stationary x=1/√(−y) and value −2√(−y); the objective has second derivative −2/x³<0. At y=0, −1/x approaches zero without attainment; y>0 gives unbounded growth as x tends to infinity.

范数平方 f(x)=N(x)²/2，可先固定半径 r=N(x)≥0。对偶界给 yᵀx≤rN*(y)，且沿取等单位方向可达到。于是只剩最大化 rN*(y)−r²/2，r=N*(y) 取等，得共轭为 N*(y)²/2。若原函数没有 1/2，结果是 N*(y)²/4。For f(x)=N(x)²/2, fix r=N(x)≥0. The sharp dual bound gives yᵀx≤rN*(y), attained along a maximizing unit direction. Maximize rN*(y)−r²/2 over r≥0 to get N*(y)²/2. Without the original factor one half, the answer is N*(y)²/4.

矩阵例子 f(X)=−log det X，域 X≻0，内积为 tr(YX)，Y 取实对称。Y≺0 时令 Q=−Y≻0，换元 U=Q½XQ½，目标变成 log det U−tr U−log det Q。逐特征值使用 log u−u≤−1，得最大值 −n−log det(−Y)，在 X=−Y⁻¹ 取得。For matrix f(X)=−log det X on X≻0, pair symmetric Y via tr(YX). If Y≺0, put Q=−Y≻0 and U=Q½XQ½. The objective becomes log det U−tr U−log det Q. Apply log u−u≤−1 to each positive eigenvalue to obtain −n−log det(−Y), attained at X=−Y⁻¹.

若 Y 不负定，即 Y≺0 失败，它有某个特征值 λ≥0。在其特征坐标下令 X 对应特征值 t→∞，其他特征值固定为 1；目标含 λt+log t，必趋 +∞。因此共轭仅在 Y≺0 有限。If Y≺0 fails, it has an eigenvalue λ≥0. In that eigenbasis let the corresponding eigenvalue of X be t tending to infinity and fix the others to one. The objective contains λt+log t, which is unbounded. Thus the conjugate is finite only for Y≺0.

5.3 Fenchel 不等式与变换5.3 Fenchel inequality and transformations

共轭定义对每个 x 都给 f*(y)≥yᵀx−f(x)。移项便是 ，它给任意一对 x、y 一个内积上界：The conjugate definition gives f*(y)≥yᵀx−f(x) for every x. Rearranging yields , bounding the inner product for any pair x,y:

先说明取等的含义：f*(y)=yᵀx−f(x) 恰好表示该 x 达到定义中的上确界。现在取 f 为正常凸函数，回顾 4.2 的次梯度定义：y 是 x 处次梯度，要求对每个 z 都有 f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x)。把这一条件重排，就得到Equality f*(y)=yᵀx−f(x) means that this x attains the defining supremum. Now take f proper convex. Recall Section 4.2: y is a subgradient at x when f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x) for every z. Rearranging this condition gives

所以在这个正常凸函数的讨论范围内，次梯度条件与 Fenchel 取等完全对应。若 f 还在开放域可微，次梯度唯一等于 ∇f(x)，就得到 y=∇f(x) 的取等判据。例如 f=x²/2，f*=y²/2，不等式为 (x−y)²/2≥0，取等恰在 x=y。For the proper convex functions considered here, the subgradient condition and equality in Fenchel coincide. If f is differentiable on an open domain, its unique subgradient is ∇f(x), giving equality at y=∇f(x). For f=x²/2 and f*=y²/2, the inequality is (x−y)²/2≥0, with equality at x=y.

计算新函数的共轭时，最好从定义换元，避免死记变换方向。常数平移 g=f+b 使目标少 b，故 g*=f*−b；加线性项 aᵀx 则把评分 y 改为 y−a。正比例 α>0 可以提出上确界：Derive transformation rules from the definition. For g=f+b the objective loses b, giving g*=f*−b. Adding aᵀx replaces y by y−a. A positive factor α pulls through the supremum as follows:

输入平移 g(x)=f(x−b)，令 u=x−b，目标变成 yᵀu−f(u)+yᵀb，所以 g*(y)=f*(y)+yᵀb。若 g(x)=f(Ax) 且 A 为可逆方阵，令 u=Ax 可得 g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)。不可逆时换元不是双射，不能照抄。For input translation g(x)=f(x−b), put u=x−b to obtain g*(y)=f*(y)+yᵀb. For g(x)=f(Ax) with invertible square A, u=Ax gives g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy). Without invertibility this is not a bijection and the rule cannot be copied.

5.4 拟凸：只要求每个达标区域凸5.4 Quasiconvexity: convex threshold regions

有些函数不满足加权平均的不等式，但“费用不超过 α”的输入区域仍然凸。第四章已经说明凸函数一定有这个性质；现在把它单独定义为。定义域 D 要凸，且对每个实数 α，次水平集 {x∈D:f(x)≤α} 都凸。Some functions fail the weighted-average inequality but still have convex regions below every cost threshold. Convex functions have this property; on its own it defines quasiconvexity. The domain D must be convex and every sublevel set {x∈D:f(x)≤α} must be convex.

等价形式是：线段上函数值不超过两端较大的值。正向取 α=max(f(x),f(y))，两端都在该次水平集中，凸性保证混合点也在其中。反向若 x、y 满足 f(x),f(y)≤α，则 max(f(x),f(y))≤α；下式就给混合点费用≤α，因此每个次水平集都凸。Equivalently, a segment value does not exceed the larger endpoint value. Forward, choose α=max(f(x),f(y)); sublevel convexity keeps the mixture inside. Conversely if both endpoint values are at most α, their maximum is at most α; the inequality below keeps the mixture in the same sublevel set.

例如 x³ 在 R 上递增，次水平集都是半直线，所以拟凸；二阶导 6x 改变符号，故它不凸。拟凹定义为所有上水平集凸；两者都满足叫拟线性。正分母的线性分式函数就是拟线性的，因为门槛比较可直接乘正分母改成半空间。The increasing x³ has half-line sublevel sets and is , but its second derivative 6x changes sign, so it is not convex. Quasiconcavity requires convex superlevel sets; both properties give quasilinearity. A positive-denominator linear-fractional function is quasilinear because threshold comparisons become halfspaces.

导数条件能说明什么？What can derivatives tell us?

对开放凸域上的可微函数，拟凸性的一个等价判据如下。必要性可以直接推：若 f(y)≤f(x)，拟凸性使从 x 朝 y 的小步不提高函数值，除以正步长并取极限，便得方向导数不正。反向也成立，是可微拟凸的一阶判据（教材3.4.3）。For differentiable functions on an open convex domain, the following characterizes quasiconvexity. Necessity is direct: if f(y)≤f(x), quasiconvexity prevents an increase along a small step from x toward y; divide by the positive step and take the limit. The converse is the differentiable quasiconvexity theorem, textbook Section 3.4.3.

拟凸的一阶判据没有给出凸函数那种全局仿射下界，尤其不能由梯度为零推出最优：x³ 在零点导数为零，负输入却有更低值。若要给候选点 x* 一个充分保证，可使用较强条件：对每个其他可行 y 都有 ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)>0。若反而存在 f(y)≤f(x*) 的点，拟凸判据就要求这个内积≤0，与严格正矛盾。因此该强条件能保证唯一最小；它只是一条充分条件。The quasiconvex first-order test is not a global affine lower bound. Zero gradient need not be optimal: x³ has zero derivative at zero but lower values at negative inputs. One sufficient guarantee for x* is the stronger condition ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)>0 for every other feasible y. Any y with f(y)≤f(x*) would instead force that inner product to be nonpositive, a contradiction. The strong condition guarantees a unique minimum but is sufficient only.

把优化变成一系列达标测试Optimization through threshold feasibility

拟凸最小化可对阈值二分。固定 α，只问是否存在可行 x 满足 f(x)≤α；这是凸集合的可行性问题。若存在，把已知可行上界 u 降到 α；若不存在，把下界 l 升到 α。始终保留最优值所在区间 [l,u]，直到 u−l≤指定容差；这要求每次可行性判断可靠。Quasiconvex minimization permits bisection over α. Test whether any feasible x has f(x)≤α, a convex feasibility problem. A feasible test lowers the upper bound u; an infeasible test raises the lower bound l. Stop when u−l meets the tolerance. The guarantee depends on reliable feasibility tests.

例如在变量区间 1≤x≤3 上最小化 f=x/(x+1)。先给最优函数值 p* 一个粗范围：0<f(x)<1，所以取 p* 的包围区间 [l,u]=[0,1]。l、u 是函数值的界，不是变量 x 的界。分母为正，阈值测试 f≤α 等价于 x≤α(x+1)。α=1/2 可行（x=1），所以上界 u 降为1/2；α=1/4 则要求 x≤1/3，与 x≥1 冲突，故下界 l 升为1/4。继续二分逼近最优值1/2。Minimize f=x/(x+1) on the variable interval 1≤x≤3. Since 0<f(x)<1, bracket the optimal function value p* by [l,u]=[0,1]. These are value bounds, not bounds on x. A positive denominator makes f≤α equivalent to x≤α(x+1). At α=1/2, x=1 is feasible, lowering u to 1/2. At α=1/4, x≤1/3 contradicts x≥1, raising l to 1/4. Bisection approaches value 1/2.

补充阅读 · 哪些运算仍拟凸Further reading · Operations preserving quasiconvexity

逐点上确界保持拟凸，因为次水平集是各次水平集的交。仿射复合保持拟凸；已定义的非减标量外函数也保持拟凸，可直接代入 max 形式的判据。和一般不保持：x³ 与 −x 都单调，故拟凸，但 x³−x 的零次水平集是 (−∞,−1]∪[0,1]，不凸。Pointwise suprema preserve quasiconvexity because sublevel sets intersect. Affine composition and defined nondecreasing scalar outer maps preserve it as well, using the max-form inequality. Sums need not: both monotone x³ and −x are quasiconvex, but x³−x has nonconvex zero sublevel set (−∞,−1]∪[0,1].

5.5 对数凸与对数凹5.5 Log-convexity and log-concavity

有些模型按比例而非差值比较正数。对于凸域上严格为正的 f，若 log f 凸，称 f ；若 log f 凹，称对数凹。先检查 f>0 才能取实数对数。Some models compare positive values multiplicatively. A positive f on a convex domain is when log f is convex and log-concave when log f is concave. Positivity is required before taking real logarithms.

这个乘法式由 log f 的凸性两边取指数得到。右边是加权几何平均，凸函数的定义右边则是加权算术平均，二者不能混淆。对数凸蕴含凸，因为 f=exp(log f)，指数凸且递增；反向不成立。Exponentiating the convexity inequality for log f gives this multiplicative form. Its right side is a weighted geometric mean, unlike the arithmetic mean in ordinary convexity. Log-convexity implies convexity through exp(log f); the converse fails.

例如 f=1+x² 是正凸函数，但 (log f)″=2(1−x²)/(1+x²)²，在 |x|>1 为负，所以不对数凸。高斯形状 则，因为 log f=−x²/2 凹；但 f″=(x²−1)f 在尾部为正，所以 f 本身不在整个 R 上凹。For f=1+x², (log f)″=2(1−x²)/(1+x²)² is negative for |x|>1, so a positive convex function need not be log-convex. The Gaussian-shaped is since its log is −x²/2; its own second derivative (x²−1)f is positive in the tails, so it is not concave on all R.

多元时对 log f 求两次导数，可得下面的统一判据。它同时需要 f 正、二阶可微和凸定义域。In multiple dimensions, differentiate log f twice for the criterion below, assuming positive f, twice differentiability and a convex domain.

分子半正定对应对数凸，半负定对应对数凹。正函数的乘积取 log 后成为和，所以对数凸函数的乘积仍对数凸，对数凹函数的乘积仍对数凹。正幂同样保持这两种性质。A PSD numerator gives log-convexity and a negative semidefinite one log-concavity. Products become sums after logarithms, so products of log-convex functions remain log-convex; likewise for log-concave functions. Positive powers preserve each property.

补充阅读 · 和与积分的区别Further reading · Sums and integration

正加权和保持对数凸。这里用到 2.8 已定义的 log-sum-exp：L(a)=log(Σᵢexp aᵢ)。2.9 的 Hessian 平方和证明它凸，各偏导 pᵢ>0 还说明它对每个坐标递增。若每个 fᵢ>0 且对数凸，wᵢ>0，则 log(Σᵢwᵢfᵢ)=L(log w₁+log f₁,…)，内层各分量凸，4.9 的复合规则便给出结果。零权重项先删去。Positive weighted sums preserve log-convexity. Use log-sum-exp L(a)=log(Σᵢexp aᵢ), defined in Section 2.8. Section 2.9 proved convexity by its Hessian square sum, and partials pᵢ>0 give coordinatewise increase. With positive log-convex fᵢ and positive wᵢ, log(Σᵢwᵢfᵢ)=L(log w₁+log f₁,…). Convex inner components and Section 4.9 composition prove the result. Remove zero-weight terms first.

对数凹函数的和一般不保持对数凹，下一段给出可直接验算的高斯反例。积分保持对数凹的 Prékopa 定理还要求联合对数凹和可积等条件，本章只列其用途，不把它当作简单加法规则。Sums of log-concave functions generally fail to preserve the property; the next paragraph gives a directly checkable Gaussian counterexample. Prékopa integration results require joint log-concavity and integrability, rather than a simple sum rule.

对数凹相加的具体反例为 g(x)=exp(−(x−2)²/2)+exp(−(x+2)²/2)。每项都对数凹，但 g(0)=2e⁻²、g′(0)=0、g″(0)=6e⁻²，因此 (log g)″(0)=3>0，不满足对数凹定义。这里由实际曲率判断，无须仅凭“双峰”外观。For a concrete counterexample, take g(x)=exp(−(x−2)²/2)+exp(−(x+2)²/2). Both terms are log-concave, but g(0)=2e⁻², g′(0)=0 and g″(0)=6e⁻², so (log g)″(0)=3>0. Thus the sum is not log-concave.

把本节一元对数二阶导公式逐项代入，零点的计算为Substitute these values into the one-variable log-curvature formula at zero:

对数凹要求 log g 的二阶导不正，这里严格为正，故这个和不是对数凹函数。Log-concavity requires a nonpositive second derivative of log g; its positive value here disproves log-concavity of the sum.

5.6 向量与矩阵意义下的凸性5.6 Convexity under vector and matrix orders

标量凸性把函数值与两端平均比较。若输出是向量或矩阵，先用第三章的正常锥 K 规定“不大于”，再使用完全相同的混合比较，就得到 K-凸函数。定义域 D 必须凸。For vector or matrix outputs, replace scalar comparison with the order of a proper cone K from Chapter 3. The same mixture comparison defines on a convex domain D.

沿用 3.7 与 3.11：正常锥是闭、凸、尖且内部非空的锥，对偶锥 K*={w:wᵀd≥0 对所有 d∈K}。3.12 已证明闭凸锥满足 d∈K 当且仅当每个对偶评分 wᵀd≥0。下面就用这条刻画，把向量不等式转为标量不等式。Recall Sections 3.7 and 3.11: a proper cone is closed, convex, pointed and has nonempty interior; K*={w:wᵀd≥0 for every d∈K}. Section 3.12 characterizes a closed convex cone by all its dual scores. We use that result to turn vector inequalities into scalar inequalities.

K 为非负正交象限时，K-凸恰好要求每个输出分量凸。K 为半正定锥时，令 M 为“平均输出减混合输出”，要求 M⪰0，称矩阵凸。判断 M⪰0 的定义是对每个 z 都有 zᵀMz≥0，而这正是标量函数 zᵀF(·)z 的凸性不等式。因此有下面的等价判据，不能把它换成逐元素凸。For the nonnegative orthant, K-convexity is componentwise convexity. For the PSD cone, let M be the averaged output minus the output at the mixture; matrix convexity requires M⪰0. By definition this means zᵀMz≥0 for every z, exactly the convexity inequality for the scalar function zᵀF(·)z. This proves the equivalence below; entrywise convexity is a different condition.

例：外积函数为什么矩阵凸？Example: why outer products are matrix convex

设 F(x)=xxᵀ。对两个输入 x、y，直接展开混合差值得For F(x)=xxᵀ, expand the mixture gap:

最后一个外积半正定，因为 zᵀ(x−y)(x−y)ᵀz=((x−y)ᵀz)²≥0。于是 F 矩阵凸，虽然其中元素 x₁x₂ 在 R² 上并不凸。对矩形矩阵 X，同样有 XXᵀ 矩阵凸，因为固定 z 后 zᵀXXᵀz=‖Xᵀz‖₂² 是凸二次函数。The outer product is PSD since its quadratic form is a square. Thus F is matrix convex even though entry x₁x₂ is not scalar convex on R². Likewise XXᵀ is matrix convex for rectangular X because zᵀXXᵀz=‖Xᵀz‖₂² is a convex quadratic.

元素 x₁x₂ 的非凸性可沿直线核对：取 x=(t,−t)，该元素为 −t²，违反标量凸性。因此矩阵凸并不要求每个元素凸。Check entry x₁x₂ along x=(t,−t): it becomes −t², which is not convex. Matrix convexity therefore does not require entrywise convexity.

一般 K-凸性也可由对偶评分判断：对每个 w∈K*，wᵀF 必须标量凸。正向由 K* 定义；反向由闭凸锥的对偶刻画，把所有评分的不等式还原为差值属于 K。General K-convexity is equivalent to scalar convexity of wᵀF for every w∈K*. Necessity follows from the dual definition; sufficiency follows from the closed-convex-cone dual characterization.

补充阅读 · 矩阵幂与严格矩阵凸Further reading · Matrix powers and strict matrix convexity

正定 X 的矩阵幂由特征分解定义：Xᵖ=Qdiag(λᵢᵖ)Qᵀ。所有阶数上统一成立的结论为：−1≤p≤0 或 1≤p≤2 时矩阵凸，0≤p≤1 时矩阵凹（教材3.6.1）。标量 xᵖ 的凸性范围更广，不能直接套来。矩阵指数 eˣ 在标量情形凸，但矩阵指数在维数≥2时一般不矩阵凸。For positive definite X define Xᵖ by powering its eigenvalues. Uniform operator results are matrix convexity for −1≤p≤0 or 1≤p≤2, and matrix concavity for 0≤p≤1, textbook Section 3.6.1. Scalar powers have a wider convexity range. The scalar exponential is convex, but the matrix exponential generally is not matrix convex in dimensions at least two.

严格矩阵凸要求非平凡混合差值正定。F(x)=xxᵀ 的差值至多秩 1，在输出维数大于 1 时不正定，所以矩阵凸不自动严格。前面的外积证明只能得到半正定，不能把符号升级。Strict matrix convexity requires a positive definite gap for distinct inputs and nontrivial mixtures. The gap for xxᵀ has rank at most one and cannot be positive definite when the output dimension exceeds one. Do not upgrade PSD to PD.

5.7 广义单调性：沿锥方向增加输入5.7 Generalized monotonicity along cone directions

最后区分两种性质：凸性比较混合点与平均输出，单调性比较两个有序输入的输出。输入空间选正常锥 K，输出空间选正常锥 L；F 单调不减指Convexity compares mixtures with averaged outputs; monotonicity compares ordered inputs. Choose a proper input cone K and output cone L. The map F is order-preserving when

下面给出导数判据，假设 F 在开放凸域 D 上可微。只检查 d∈K，因为这正是锥序认为输入增加的方向。若 F 单调，对足够小 ε>0，x+εd 仍在 D，且 εd∈K；输出差因此在 L 中。除以正数 ε 仍在锥 L 中，令 ε↓0 并用 L 闭，得到For the derivative criterion, assume F differentiable on an open convex D. Check d∈K because these directions count as input increases. If F is order-preserving, then for small ε>0, x+εd stays in D and εd∈K, so the output difference belongs to L. Divide by positive ε and use closedness of L as ε decreases to zero:

这证明必要性。反向假设下面的导数条件处处成立，接着用对偶评分证明它足以推出全局单调性。This proves necessity. Conversely, assume the derivative condition below at every point; dual scores will establish global monotonicity.

把充分性逐步写出：取任意有序输入 x、y，令 d=y−x∈K，并固定任意 w∈L*。定义一元函数 h(t)=wᵀF(x+td)，0≤t≤1。凸域保证整条线段允许，导数条件给For sufficiency, choose any ordered inputs x,y and set d=y−x∈K. Fix any w∈L* and define h(t)=wᵀF(x+td) for 0≤t≤1. Domain convexity permits the whole segment; the derivative condition yields

这里用一元导数非负则函数不减，故 wᵀ(F(y)−F(x))≥0。对每个 w∈L* 都成立，再由 3.12 的闭凸锥对偶刻画得到 F(y)−F(x)∈L，这才完成全局单调性的证明。A nonnegative one-variable derivative makes h nondecreasing, so wᵀ(F(y)−F(x))≥0. This holds for every w∈L*, and Section 3.12 dual characterization yields F(y)−F(x)∈L, completing global monotonicity.

对于线性 F(x)=Ax，这就简化为 AK⊆L。在两个正交象限之间，等价于 A 每个元素非负：用坐标单位向量分别测试各列即可。若输出为标量，则要求梯度属于 K*。For linear F(x)=Ax, the condition reduces to AK⊆L. Between nonnegative orthants it means every entry of A is nonnegative, verified by testing coordinate unit vectors. For scalar output it means the gradient lies in K*.

例：矩阵求逆会反转半正定序Example: inversion reverses the PSD order

设 A⪰B≻0。将比较同时乘 B⁻½ 得 C=B⁻½AB⁻½⪰I，C 的特征值均至少为 1，故 C⁻¹⪯I。再把坐标换回，得到For A⪰B≻0, congruence by B⁻½ gives C=B⁻½AB⁻½⪰I. All eigenvalues of C are at least one, so C⁻¹⪯I. Transform back to obtain

这证明了求逆在半正定序下单调不增。下面再用 4.5 的矩阵分式函数验证它的矩阵凸性。另需注意，标量 t² 在正半轴递增，不能据此认定矩阵平方保持序；矩阵不交换时，A²−B² 不能当成普通数的 (A−B)(A+B) 来判断。This proves inversion is order-reversing. Next use the matrix fractional function from Section 4.5 to verify its matrix convexity. Also note that increasing scalar t² does not make matrix squaring order-preserving: with noncommuting matrices, A²−B² cannot be treated as the scalar product (A−B)(A+B).

求逆的矩阵凸性还可由 4.5 直接验证：对每个固定 z，zᵀX⁻¹z 是矩阵分式函数的一个截面，因而关于 X 凸；再用 5.6 的标量化判据即可。这个证明与刚才的单调不增是两项独立判断。Matrix convexity of inversion follows directly from Section 4.5: for each fixed z, zᵀX⁻¹z is a convex slice of the matrix fractional function. Apply Section 5.6 scalarization. This proof and the order-reversing argument establish separate properties.

练习Exercise

线性映射 A=[[1,−1],[0,2]] 是否保持非负正交象限的顺序？Does A=[[1,−1],[0,2]] preserve orthant order?

提示Hint

用一个非负坐标单位向量测试负元素所在的列。Test the column containing the negative entry with a nonnegative coordinate vector.

解答与核对Solution and check

不保持。取 x=(0,0)、y=(0,1)，有 x≤y，但 Ax=(0,0)、Ay=(−1,2)，第一坐标下降。负元素已给出一个明确反例。No. For x=(0,0), y=(0,1), x≤y but Ax=(0,0) and Ay=(−1,2), whose first coordinate decreases. The negative entry gives a counterexample.

norm‖x‖

满足非负且仅零向量取零、绝对齐次性及三角不等式的长度度量。A length measure satisfying definiteness, absolute homogeneity and the triangle inequality.

正文Read
unit ballB

所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.

正文Read
inner productzᵀx

这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.

正文Read
supremumsup

sup 是 supremum 的缩写。上确界是能够挡住所有可能数值的最小上界；它可以存在而没有任何点实际达到它。例如 x∈(0,1) 时，x 的上确界是 1，但没有最大值。The abbreviation sup stands for supremum. A supremum is the least upper bound on all possible values, and it may exist without being attained. For x∈(0,1), the supremum of x is one, but there is no maximum.

正文Read
maximummax

max 是 maximum 的缩写。说一个数是最大值，需要找到一个可行点实际取得这个数，还需要说明其他可行点都不超过它。本章的有限维闭单位球上，线性目标可以取得最大值。The abbreviation max stands for maximum. A maximum is both attained by a feasible point and at least as large as every other feasible value. The linear objective in this chapter attains a maximum on the finite-dimensional closed unit ball.

正文Read
dual norm‖z‖*

先选定一个原范数，再固定向量 z。让 x 在原范数的单位球中移动，计算每个可行 x 的 zᵀx。所有这些内积的最大值，就是 z 的对偶范数。它的数值取决于原范数使用的长度规则。Choose a primal norm and fix a vector z. Let x vary over the primal unit ball and evaluate zᵀx at every feasible x. The largest value is the dual norm of z. Its value depends on the length rule used by the primal norm.

正文Read
support functionh_B(z)

给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.

正文Read
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1

共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.

正文Read
Cauchy–Schwarz inequality|uᵀv|≤‖u‖₂‖v‖₂

这个不等式给欧氏内积一个长度上界。两个非零向量同向时，uᵀv 等于长度的乘积；方向偏离时，内积会变小。本章用它先找上界，再沿正确方向构造达到上界的向量。This inequality bounds a Euclidean inner product by the product of the vector lengths. For nonzero vectors pointing in the same direction, uᵀv equals that product; changing their relative direction reduces the inner product. We use it to find a bound and then construct an attaining vector.

正文Read
positive definite matrixP≻0 / PD

PD = Positive Definite，正定。这里 P 必须是实对称矩阵；对每个非零向量 x，都有 xᵀPx>0。这个条件让每一个非零方向都有正的长度代价，并保证 P 可以求逆。PD = Positive Definite（正定）. Here P is real and symmetric, and xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero vector x. Every nonzero direction therefore has a positive length cost, and P is invertible.

正文Read
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSD

PSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定。对实对称矩阵 P，要求所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0；允许某个非零向量的二次型为零。因此 P 可能不可逆，√(xᵀPx) 也可能不满足范数“非零向量长度为正”的要求。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）. For a real symmetric P, xᵀPx≥0 for every x, but the quadratic form can vanish at a nonzero vector. P may be singular, and √(xᵀPx) may fail the definiteness requirement of a norm.

正文Read
quadratic norm‖x‖P

由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.

正文Read
matrix square rootP½

对正定 P，P½ 表示一个正定矩阵 S，使得 S²=P。它通常不能通过对每个矩阵元素分别开平方得到。利用正交特征分解，把正特征值逐个开平方，可以构造这个 S。For positive definite P, P½ denotes a positive definite matrix S satisfying S²=P. It is generally not obtained by taking square roots of individual matrix entries. An orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition constructs S by taking square roots of the positive eigenvalues.

正文Read
maximizerx* / argmax

最大化点是一个可行向量：把它代入目标后，目标实际达到最大值。本章 x* 上的星号标记我们选出的最大化点。x* 是向量，最大值是一个数；这两种对象需要分清。A maximizer is a feasible vector at which the objective attains its maximum. The star on x* marks such a chosen vector. A maximizer is a vector, while the maximum value is a number; they are different kinds of objects.
